name: AMS.MEL.ABI_Version
label: AMS.MEL.ABI_Version
text: function ABI_Version return Version; -- Major and minor version of the consumer-side C facade ABI. -- These numbers are not the Common MEL API string or provider versions. -- @field Major Major ABI version reported by the linked native bridge. -- @field Minor Minor ABI version reported by the linked native bridge. function ABI_Version return Version;

name: AMS.MEL.API_Version
label: AMS.MEL.API_Version
text: function API_Version (Value : Provider_Version) return Provider_Version_Number; -- Ada-owned snapshot of provider API/library numbers and descriptive text. -- A default value has zero numbers and empty strings. Queried values remain -- usable after the Session closes; they contain no live provider reference. function API_Version (Value : Provider_Version) return Provider_Version_Number;

name: AMS.MEL.Async_Request_Limit
label: AMS.MEL.Async_Request_Limit
text: type Async_Request_Limit is mod 2**32 with Size => 32; -- Asynchronous submission refused by bridge admission before provider send. -- Distinct from a provider rejecting a command. Submission wrappers do not -- queue or retry a refused request. type Async_Request_Limit is mod 2**32 with Size => 32;

name: AMS.MEL.Close
label: AMS.MEL.Close
text: procedure Close (Object : in out Session); -- Query Control version information and copy its numbers and complete text -- into Ada storage. Native validation requires UTF-8 text without NUL. -- The two-call size/copy protocol is not a provider version negotiation. -- @param Object Open Session; serialize this query against Close. -- @return Independent snapshot with full 32-bit numbers and Ada-owned text. -- @exception Provider_Error The Session is closed, the provider query fails, -- or the text is invalid or cannot be copied by the native protocol. -- @exception Program_Error The native protocol reports a zero required -- string-buffer size. procedure Close (Object : in out Session);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Byte
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Byte
text: subtype Byte is Interfaces.Unsigned_8; -- IR foundation values and the legacy copied-frame image stream. This -- stream supports host-memory, single-band, eight-bit monochrome images; -- it performs no decoding, flipping, resampling or coordinate transforms. -- The richer image child package has separate full-header and frame-lease -- APIs; their capabilities must not be inferred for this legacy Frame. subtype Byte is Interfaces.Unsigned_8;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Capabilities
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Capabilities
text: function Capabilities (Channel : Control_Channel) return IR.Channel.Channel_Capability; -- Idempotently clear the public observer without cancelling its future. -- Pending native accounting and provider retention survive independently; -- unexpected native failure raises a provider error. -- @param Request Legacy observer to close, externally serialized against Wait. function Capabilities (Channel : Control_Channel) return IR.Channel.Channel_Capability;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Close
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Close
text: procedure Close (Request : in out Comms_Request); -- Await a terminal report/rejection through the shared native Comms engine. -- Results are cached for repeat waits. Timeout raises the inherited timeout -- exception without cancellation or consumption; other native failures raise -- a provider error. Long rejection text is retried and consistency checked. -- Unlike the canonical Ada wrapper, this legacy body directly converts the -- native rejection number; native enum mapping still rejects unknown codes. -- @param Request Open legacy observer; must not race Close. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls. -- @return Owned legacy result, independent of later metadata callbacks. procedure Close (Request : in out Comms_Request);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Comms_Request
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Comms_Request
text: type Comms_Request is limited private; -- Submit inherited keep-alive while C2 is Attached or Enabled, without -- implicitly enabling. Uses the shared native Return completion engine and -- Session admission pool. Exhaustion raises the resource-exhaustion exception; -- other native failures raise a provider error. Submission is not completion. -- @param Channel Open eligible C2 owner; serialize its operations externally. -- @return C2 Return observer; use the parent package's Wait/Close and inspect payload separately from outcome. type Comms_Request is limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Comms_Result
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Comms_Result
text: type Comms_Result is private; -- Submit inherited communications test while Attached or Enabled. The -- provider send runs after an accounted native lifetime claim. Session -- admission refusal raises the resource-exhaustion exception; closed/failed -- channels and other native failures raise a provider error. -- @param Channel Open eligible C2 owner; externally serialize owner operations. -- @param Channel_ID Unsigned communications-test selector, not a channel UCI identity. -- @param Command_ID Canonical command identifier through its C2 compatibility subtype. -- @param Request_ID Unsigned communications-test correlation identifier. -- @return Legacy observer of an admitted future, not evidence of provider acceptance. type Comms_Result is private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Description
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Description
text: function Description (Result : Comms_Result) return String with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected; -- Read the rejection category under the declared Rejected precondition; -- there is no independent body check. -- @param Result Rejected legacy communications-test result. -- @return C2 error category mapped from the upstream rejection, not bridge admission failure. function Description (Result : Comms_Result) return String with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Rejection_Code
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Rejection_Code
text: function Rejection_Code (Result : Comms_Result) return Error_Code with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected; -- Copy the report under the declared Success precondition. The expression -- body adds no independent outcome check when assertions are disabled. -- @param Result Successful legacy result. -- @return Shared Channel report containing provider-returned command/request IDs. function Rejection_Code (Result : Comms_Result) return Error_Code with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Report

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Send_Keep_Alive
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Send_Keep_Alive
text: function Send_Keep_Alive (Channel : Control_Channel) return Return_Request; -- Historical C2-only access to inherited common Channel operations. The -- canonical common facade supports all five typed families through weak -- views; this compatibility child takes a typed C2 owner directly. Channel -- selectors and reports are shared with the common package, but the C2 -- Return owner/result and this child's Comms owner/result remain distinct -- Ada types. Handles cannot be substituted across these APIs. These are -- wrappers of existing upstream Channel services, not additional services. -- Serialize typed-owner operations externally and do not race request Close -- against Wait. Native pending work independently retains provider lifetime. function Send_Keep_Alive (Channel : Control_Channel) return Return_Request;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.Submit_Comms_Test

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Is_Open (overload 1/4)
text: function Is_Open (Stream : Metadata_Stream) return Boolean; -- Attempt one-shot registration in order: BIT configuration, command status, -- BIT status. No capability-advertisement gate or automatic communications -- registration is used here. Native code rejects a closed channel or prior -- metadata attempt; unlike sends it does not require Enabled. Partial failure -- leaves installed callbacks safely retaining inactive/failed queue state, -- marks the attempt consumed and raises a provider error; reopening is not -- a registration rollback. No partially open Ada stream escapes. -- @param Channel Open typed C2 owner on which registration has not been attempted. -- @param Queue_Capacity Positive maximum queued events, default sixteen. -- @return Owned consumer for the three base callback families. function Is_Open (Stream : Metadata_Stream) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Is_Open (overload 2/4)
text: function Is_Open (Stream : Camera_Protection_Stream) return Boolean; -- Registers the upstream C2Channel CameraProtectCmdResp overload once per C2 channel while -- Attached or Enabled, including after failure. Registration may deliver synchronously. -- Failure publishes no owner; the retained callback stays inactive because upstream has no -- unregister. Every response is copied before the callback returns into one bounded -- drop-incoming queue in arrival order; null payloads and unknown CmdResp values are counted -- as malformed and never remapped. The owner stops when the C2 channel is physically -- released, after in-flight callbacks return. Delivery never completes a request. -- @param Channel Open, Attached or Enabled typed C2 owner. -- @param Queue_Capacity Positive maximum queued responses, default sixteen. -- @return Limited CameraProtectCmdResp consumption owner. -- @exception AMS.MEL.IR.Camera_Protection.Not_Supported Provider answered NotSupported. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed/ineligible channel, repeated attempt, other registration -- failure, provider exception during registration or native failure. function Is_Open (Stream : Camera_Protection_Stream) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Is_Open (overload 3/4)
text: function Is_Open (Stream : Calibration_Configuration_Stream) return Boolean; -- Registers the upstream C2Channel CalibrationConfiguration overload once per C2 channel while -- Attached or Enabled, including after failure. Registration may deliver synchronously. -- Failure publishes no owner; the retained callback stays inactive because upstream has no -- unregister. Every complete configuration is copied before the callback returns into one bounded -- drop-incoming queue in arrival order; null payloads and invalid calibration values are counted -- as malformed and never remapped. The owner stops when the C2 channel is physically -- released, after in-flight callbacks return. Delivery never completes a request. -- @param Channel Open, Attached or Enabled typed C2 owner. -- @param Queue_Capacity Positive maximum queued responses, default sixteen. -- @return Limited CalibrationConfiguration consumption owner. -- @exception AMS.MEL.IR.Calibration_Configuration.Not_Supported Provider answered NotSupported. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed/ineligible channel, repeated attempt, other registration -- failure, provider exception during registration or native failure. function Is_Open (Stream : Calibration_Configuration_Stream) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Is_Open (overload 4/4)
text: function Is_Open (Stream : Calibration_Status_Stream) return Boolean; -- Registers the upstream C2Channel CalibrationStatus overload once per C2 channel while -- Attached or Enabled, including after failure. Registration may deliver synchronously. -- Failure publishes no owner; the retained callback stays inactive because upstream has no -- unregister. Every complete status is copied before the callback returns into one bounded -- drop-incoming queue in arrival order; null payloads and invalid status values are counted -- as malformed and never remapped. The owner stops when the C2 channel is physically -- released, after in-flight callbacks return. Delivery never completes or cancels a request. -- @param Channel Open, Attached or Enabled typed C2 owner. -- @param Queue_Capacity Positive maximum queued statuses, default sixteen. -- @return Limited CalibrationStatus consumption owner. -- @exception AMS.MEL.IR.Calibration_Status.Not_Supported Provider answered NotSupported. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed/ineligible channel, repeated attempt, other registration -- failure, provider exception during registration or native failure. function Is_Open (Stream : Calibration_Status_Stream) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Kind
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Kind
text: function Kind (Event : Metadata_Event) return Metadata_Kind; -- Pop the oldest successfully enqueued snapshot. Already queued events -- drain before stopped/failed state is reported. Empty active queue timeout -- raises the inherited timeout exception; stopped/inactive queue raises -- the inherited stopped-stream exception; native/callback terminal failure raises a provider error. -- Conversion validates enums and releases native event storage on exceptions. -- @param Stream Open queue consumer, externally serialized against Close. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; default zero polls. -- @return Owned event of any enabled kind, independent of request Wait results. function Kind (Event : Metadata_Event) return Metadata_Kind;

No independent body kind check is performed. -- @param Event Communications-test metadata event, not a Comms future result. -- @return Owned shared Channel report containing command/request identifiers. type Metadata_Counters is record Events_Received, Events_Dropped_Queue_Full, Malformed_Or_Unsupported : Counter; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Metadata_Kind
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Metadata_Kind
text: type Metadata_Kind is (Command_Status_Event, BIT_Configuration_Event, BIT_Status_Event, Channel_Comms_Test_Event); -- Separately attempt communications-test callback registration once per C2 -- channel while Attached or Enabled. An expired channel, repeated attempt, -- provider refusal or exception raises a provider error. The attempt flag is -- set before registration, so failure is not retryable. No capability gate -- is applied and no other callback registration is undone. Native code checks -- channel lifecycle, not an additional queue-active condition; this operation -- does not revive an inactive consumer. A closed stream cannot be used. -- @param Stream Open stream whose channel admits this first registration attempt. type Metadata_Kind is (Command_Status_Event, BIT_Configuration_Event, BIT_Status_Event, Channel_Comms_Test_Event);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Metadata_Stream
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Metadata_Stream
text: type Metadata_Stream is limited private; -- Owned inbound C2 command/BIT metadata and optional communications reports. -- Command status is independent of request Wait: accepting a command is not -- physical completion and the bridge supplies no additional correlation -- guarantee. All kinds share a bounded drop-incoming queue ordered by -- successful enqueue, not timestamps. Serialize stream operations and Close. type Metadata_Stream is limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Open
text: function Open (Channel : Control_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive := 16) return Metadata_Stream; -- Limited controlled consumer of a native metadata queue. Provider callbacks -- retain queue state independently; the stream has only a weak channel link. -- Closing cannot unregister callbacks because upstream provides no unregister. function Open (Channel : Control_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive := 16) return Metadata_Stream;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.Open_Calibration_Configuration

Open never -- registers this callback, so providers without calibration configuration keep every existing C2 -- operation unchanged. Explicit Close is preferred; finalization attempts non-raising cleanup. -- Serialize operations on the same owner. function Open_Calibration_Configuration (Channel : Control_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive := 16) return Calibration_Configuration_Stream;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Camera_Request_Owner

text: type Camera_Request_Owner is tagged limited private; -- Release the public stream owner through native detach/cleanup. Repeated -- closure of a closed owner is harmless. Retained frames/requests or uncertain -- cleanup can retain the provider graph rather than unloading unsafe code. -- @param Object Stream to close; do not race closure with Receive or other -- operations on this Ada owner. -- @exception Provider_Error Native cleanup fails; explicit closure allows -- the caller to observe the failure instead of relying on finalization. -- Controlled owner of exactly one native weak common Channel view -- (ams_mel_ir_channel). Applications use it only through the subtype -- AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.View; its operations live in AMS.MEL.IR.Channel and -- the typed-family As_Channel conversions. It never owns the typed family -- state, Session, provider Channel, Control, or provider library. -- IRMEL-ADA-003 limited controlled owner of exactly one native CameraCommand -- request. Applications use it only through AMS.MEL.IR.Camera.Camera_Request; -- C2 and Image submissions fill it from their own private handles. type Camera_Request_Owner is tagged limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Counter
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Counter
text: type Counter is mod 2**64 with Size => 64; -- Receive a copied legacy frame using native size-discovery then copy calls. -- At most one task may call Receive on this stream at a time. Queued frames -- precede stopped/failure reporting. Serialize closure against this call. -- @param Object Open legacy image stream whose next frame is consumed. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Wait duration in milliseconds; zero polls -- without waiting. A timeout neither stops the stream nor cancels provider work. -- @return Ada-owned pixels and selected scalar metadata for the next frame. -- @exception Timeout_Error No frame becomes available within the wait. -- @exception Stream_Stopped No queued frame remains and the stream is stopped. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed/failed stream, size discovery failure or -- a frame outside this wrapper's Mono8 single-band metadata profile. type Counter is mod 2**64 with Size => 64;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Is_Open

text: function Is_Open (Channel : Health_Channel) return Boolean; -- Attaches a HealthAndStatus channel, verifies its dynamic type and advertised channel -- capability, and publishes an owner only on success. Does not enable it. Metadata -- registration and capability queries are allowed while attached, before Enable. Native -- validation requires UTF-8 identity/location text without embedded NUL. Failed -- attachment/type validation attempts cleanup; uncertain detach retains the provider graph. -- @param Parent Open IR Session whose provider supplies the child channel. -- @param Config Complete attachment identity and sensor location. -- @return Attached, not yet enabled, limited health-channel owner. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed Session, invalid configuration text, provider -- attachment/capability/type failure or native failure. function Is_Open (Channel : Health_Channel) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Open
text: function Open (Parent : Session; Config : Health_Config) return Health_Channel; -- Limited typed owner, initially closed. Open attaches; Enable is explicit. Native state -- retains the Session/provider while this child needs it. Closing the public Session does not -- invalidate an existing channel. A weak common view does not keep this typed owner alive. -- Finalization attempts non-raising cleanup; failed detach can deliberately retain native -- resources for safety. Serialize lifecycle operations on the same Ada owner. function Open (Parent : Session; Config : Health_Config) return Health_Channel;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Acquire_Frame
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Acquire_Frame
text: function Acquire_Frame (Object : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Frame_Lease; -- Limited owner of one native snapshot retaining a provider-owned registered host buffer. The -- Frame Lease borrowed path performs no bulk image-payload copy from the MEL provider's -- registered host buffer into Ada. This is not end-to-end sensor zero-copy: pinned Squall -- copies UDP bytes into that host buffer; no DMA or kernel/network-stack zero-copy is claimed. -- Small metadata is copied at acquisition. A held lease keeps a provider buffer checked out; -- slow consumers cause backpressure or possible provider drops. Public stream/Session closure -- can be logical while physical teardown remains deferred behind leases, requests and release -- obligations. Closing the final child can trigger retained cleanup. Finalization is -- non-raising and can deliberately retain resources after uncertain release. Do not race -- lifecycle operations on a shared Ada object. Independent already-acquired leases may be -- processed separately; the stream still supports only one receive/acquire consumer. function Acquire_Frame (Object : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Frame_Lease;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Close
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Close (overload 2/2)
text: procedure Close (Request : in out Navigation_Request); -- Submit a complete CameraCommand through ImageChannel::send(CameraCommand) while the stream -- is Attached or Running, never through C2. Every field is copied exactly; the provider is -- called without bridge locks. A pending request retains the stream's provider graph after -- request, stream Stop/Close and Session closure; stream teardown is deferred and the command -- is not cancelled. The opt-in Image CameraCommandResp callback is an independent source and -- never completes this request. Admission exhaustion raises the resource-exhaustion -- exception; a closed/stopped stream and other failures raise a provider error. -- @param Object Attached or running image stream. -- @param Command Complete owned command to copy. -- @return Limited request owner whose result may report Command_Success False. procedure Close (Request : in out Navigation_Request);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Copy_Pixels
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Copy_Pixels
text: function Copy_Pixels (Frame : Frame_Lease) return AMS.MEL.IR.Pixel_Array with Pre => Is_Open (Frame); -- Synchronously invokes Process with a read-only-by-contract array aliasing native/provider -- storage, without a bulk payload copy. Array bounds are one through the byte count (one -- through zero if empty). The borrow ends when Process returns or raises: do not retain an -- address, slice, view or access object beyond that invocation. Keep the owning lease open -- throughout processing and do not race its Close. An exception from Process propagates -- without consuming the lease. Requires an open lease; enabled precondition checking raises -- Assertion Error on violation, while the body separately raises Provider Error for a closed -- handle or invalid payload address. No general thread safety or callback-quiescence guarantee -- is implied. -- @param Frame Open owning lease which must remain open throughout Process. -- @param Process Synchronous read-only processor; must not retain any reference to borrowed -- storage. function Copy_Pixels (Frame : Frame_Lease) return AMS.MEL.IR.Pixel_Array with Pre => Is_Open (Frame);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Is_Open (overload 1/2)
text: function Is_Open (Frame : Frame_Lease) return Boolean; -- A control-only attachment raises Provider_Error; it has no image leases. -- Dequeues and owns one native snapshot, copying only small metadata and retaining the -- provider payload by address and length. Uses the same Mono8 single-band validated queue as -- owned Receive. At most one receive/acquire consumer may operate on a stream at once; -- independent acquired leases can be processed separately. Stream Stop/Close stops admission -- and can defer physical cleanup without invalidating held leases. Provider callbacks and -- navigation completion are synchronized internally, not permission for arbitrary concurrent -- operations on one Ada owner. -- @param Object Image stream to consume; Start admits image callbacks. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Queue wait in milliseconds; zero is a nonblocking poll. -- @return Limited owner of one checked-out provider buffer and copied metadata. -- @exception Timeout_Error No frame is available within the wait; does not stop the stream. -- @exception Stream_Stopped Stream is logically stopped and no frame is available. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed/failed stream, invalid converted metadata or payload span, -- or native failure. function Is_Open (Frame : Frame_Lease) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Is_Open (overload 2/2)
text: function Is_Open (Request : Navigation_Request) return Boolean; -- Submits the supplied report while the stream is logically Attached or Running; Start is not -- required. Synchronously copies the report into the provider representation and returns a -- request, not proof of completion or acceptance. Provider send executes outside the frame -- callback lock so synchronous metadata callbacks can proceed. Application operations on the -- same stream owner require external serialization. Pending navigation requests and image -- leases independently delay physical cleanup after logical Stop/Close; corrected native -- teardown synchronization adopts actual cleanup outcomes. -- @param Object Attached or running image stream to which the report is sent. -- @param Report Provided navigation solution and all detailed kinematics; no solution is -- computed here. -- @return Open limited request handle; use Wait for the terminal response. -- @exception Provider_Error Invalid stream lifecycle, provider send failure or native -- submission failure. -- @exception Resource_Exhausted Shared asynchronous-request admission limit reached. function Is_Open (Request : Navigation_Request) return Boolean;

Validity bits are preserved but -- their positions are not defined by the pinned header. -- @field System_Time_NS Provider system time in nanoseconds; clock and epoch are unspecified. -- @field Pointing_Angle Azimuth/elevation angles relative to the sensor, in radians. -- @field Pointing_Angle_Rates Provider pointing-rate components represented by AzEl; the -- pinned report does not explicitly establish rate units. -- @field At_Speed Provider indication that the MFA is at scan speed, subject to the validity -- field. -- @field In_Tolerance Provider indication that the MFA is within desired-position tolerance, -- subject to the validity field. -- @field Platform_Attitude Platform Euler attitude; consult the canonical Status Euler -- description and the validity field. -- @field Validity_Flag_Bitfield Raw validity value for at-speed, in-tolerance and -- platform-attitude fields; no bit positions are invented. -- @field Image_Rotation_Rad Provider image rotation in radians; no rotation is applied by the -- bridge. type Line_Of_Sight_Euler is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; Attitude : AMS.MEL.Status.Euler; Attitude_Rates : AMS.MEL.Status.Euler; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.Metadata_Event
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.Metadata_Event
text: type Metadata_Event is private; -- Limited owner of public metadata consumption. Callback state belongs to the image stream and -- can outlive this public owner. Close deactivates consumption, not provider callback -- unregistration; finalization attempts non-raising cleanup. Serialize operations on the same -- Ada owner. type Metadata_Event is private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.Metadata_Kind
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.Metadata_Kind
text: type Metadata_Kind is (Bad_Pixel_List_Event, Line_Of_Sight_Report_Event, Line_Of_Sight_Euler_Event, Navigation_Response_Event); -- Owned polling of four image metadata callback families: bad pixels, line-of-sight report, -- line-of-sight Euler and navigation response. Other upstream callbacks are not bound by -- Open. Payloads are copied at the native callback boundary and again into safe Ada values; -- no provider pointer is exposed. Optional NUC_TempData has a separate opt-in owner, -- NUC_Stream, so Open is unaffected by providers without NUC support. CameraCommandResp -- (@RequiredIfCameraCtrl) likewise has its own opt-in owner, Camera_Response_Stream, -- optional OpticalDistortionMap has its own opt-in owner, Optical_Distortion_Map_Stream, and -- LineOfSightQuaternion (@RequiredIfLOSQuaternion) has its own opt-in owner, -- Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion_Stream; Open never registers any of them. type Metadata_Kind is (Bad_Pixel_List_Event, Line_Of_Sight_Report_Event, Line_Of_Sight_Euler_Event, Navigation_Response_Event);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.Metadata_Stream
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.Metadata_Stream
text: type Metadata_Stream is limited private; -- Saturating unsigned callback counters shared across the four kinds; these count callback -- activity, not successful Ada Receive calls. -- @field Events_Received Callback entries observed, incremented even when consumption has -- become inactive. -- @field Events_Dropped_Queue_Full Valid copied incoming events discarded because the bounded -- queue is full; existing events are retained. -- @field Malformed_Or_Unsupported Null, unsupported or malformed events and copying/allocation -- failures rejected at the callback boundary. type Metadata_Stream is limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.Receive
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.Receive
text: function Receive (Stream : Metadata_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Metadata_Event; -- Registers all four supported callbacks on an attached or running image stream, once per -- image stream, including after registration failure. Prefer registration before Start to -- avoid missing early events. A failed or unsupported registration raises Provider Error and -- publishes no metadata owner; already registered callbacks retain inactive state until -- provider-channel destruction because upstream supplies no unregister operation. All kinds -- share one bounded drop-incoming queue, ordered by successful enqueue under its mutex, not by -- timestamps or concurrent callback entry order. Closing metadata does not close the image -- stream. -- @param Stream Owning image stream, not stopping, stopped or failed. -- @param Queue_Capacity Maximum number of queued events across all four kinds. -- @return Limited metadata-consumption owner. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed/ineligible stream, repeated registration attempt, -- registration rejection/exception or native failure. function Receive (Stream : Metadata_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Metadata_Event;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.Receive_Camera_Response
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.Receive_Camera_Response
text: function Receive_Camera_Response (Stream : Camera_Response_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return AMS.MEL.IR.Camera.Camera_Command_Response; -- Registers the upstream ImageChannel CameraCommandResp callback once per image stream, -- including after failure. Registration may deliver synchronously. Failure publishes no -- owner; the retained callback stays inactive because upstream has no unregister. Responses -- are copied before the callback returns into one bounded drop-incoming queue; the owner -- stops with the stream. Delivery never proves a CameraCommand request completed. -- @param Stream Attached or running image stream. -- @param Queue_Capacity Maximum number of queued responses. -- @return Limited CameraCommandResp consumption owner. -- @exception AMS.MEL.IR.Camera.Not_Supported Provider answered NotSupported. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed/ineligible stream, repeated attempt, other registration -- failure or exception, or native failure. function Receive_Camera_Response (Stream : Camera_Response_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return AMS.MEL.IR.Camera.Camera_Command_Response;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.Receive_Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.Receive_Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion
text: function Receive_Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion (Stream : Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return AMS.MEL.IR.Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion.Line_Of_Sight_Value; -- Registers the upstream ImageChannel LineOfSightQuaternion callback once per image stream, -- including after failure. Registration may deliver synchronously. Failure publishes no -- owner; the retained callback stays inactive because upstream has no unregister. Each value -- is copied before the callback returns into one bounded drop-incoming queue; a full queue -- drops values without copying them, and a null payload is counted malformed. No -- normalization or other validity rule is applied. The owner stops with the stream. -- @param Stream Attached or running image stream. -- @param Queue_Capacity Maximum number of queued values. -- @return Limited LineOfSightQuaternion consumption owner. -- @exception AMS.MEL.IR.Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion.Not_Supported Provider answered -- NotSupported. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed/ineligible stream, repeated attempt, other registration -- failure or exception, or native failure. function Receive_Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion (Stream : Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return AMS.MEL.IR.Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion.Line_Of_Sight_Value;

Registration may deliver synchronously. Failure publishes no owner; the -- retained callback stays inactive because upstream has no unregister. Events share one -- bounded drop-incoming queue in successful-enqueue order; the owner stops with the stream. -- @param Stream Attached or running image stream. -- @param Queue_Capacity Maximum number of queued NUC_TempData messages. -- @return Limited NUC consumption owner. -- @exception AMS.MEL.IR.NUC.Not_Supported Provider answered NotSupported. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed/ineligible stream, repeated attempt, other registration -- failure or exception, or native failure. function Receive_NUC (Stream : NUC_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return AMS.MEL.IR.NUC.NUC_Temp_Data;

P denotes position and V -- velocity; n, e and d identify North, East and Down. The pinned covariance declaration does -- not explicitly state units. -- @field Position_Position_Pn_Pn Covariance term for north position and north position, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Position_Position_Pn_Pe Covariance term for north position and east position, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Position_Position_Pn_Pd Covariance term for north position and down position, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Position_Position_Pe_Pe Covariance term for east position and east position, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Position_Position_Pe_Pd Covariance term for east position and down position, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Position_Position_Pd_Pd Covariance term for down position and down position, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Position_Velocity_Pn_Vn Covariance term for north position and north velocity, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Position_Velocity_Pn_Ve Covariance term for north position and east velocity, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Position_Velocity_Pn_Vd Covariance term for north position and down velocity, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Position_Velocity_Pe_Ve Covariance term for east position and east velocity, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Position_Velocity_Pe_Vd Covariance term for east position and down velocity, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Position_Velocity_Pd_Vd Covariance term for down position and down velocity, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Velocity_Velocity_Vn_Vn Covariance term for north velocity and north velocity, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Velocity_Velocity_Vn_Ve Covariance term for north velocity and east velocity, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Velocity_Velocity_Vn_Vd Covariance term for north velocity and down velocity, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Velocity_Velocity_Ve_Ve Covariance term for east velocity and east velocity, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Velocity_Velocity_Ve_Vd Covariance term for east velocity and down velocity, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. -- @field Velocity_Velocity_Vd_Vd Covariance term for down velocity and down velocity, -- preserving this distinct upstream entry. type Navigation_Report is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; State : Position_Solution_State; Latitude_Rad : Long_Float; Longitude_Rad : Long_Float; Altitude_M : Long_Float; Attitude : AMS.MEL.Status.Euler; Attitude_Rate : Image.Attitude_Rate; Speed : North_East_Down; Acceleration : North_East_Down; Wander_Angle_Rad : Long_Float; Magnetic_Heading : Long_Float; Altitude_MSL : Long_Float; Position_Velocity_Covariance : Image.Position_Velocity_Covariance; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Navigation_Response

text: type Navigation_Response is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; Command_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Request_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; end record; -- Complete supplied Common MEL navigation report. Submission transmits these values; it does -- not estimate, normalize or transform kinematics. Angle, altitude and velocity units below -- follow the pinned header only. -- @field System_Time_NS System time for the report in nanoseconds; no clock or epoch is -- specified. -- @field State Reported aircraft position-solution state. -- @field Latitude_Rad Latitude in radians. -- @field Longitude_Rad Longitude in radians. -- @field Altitude_M Altitude in meters; no additional datum is imposed by the bridge. -- @field Attitude Euler attitude; see the canonical Status Euler definition. -- @field Attitude_Rate Euler attitude rate and its separate timestamp; rate units are not -- explicitly specified upstream. -- @field Speed North/East/Down speed in meters per second. -- @field Acceleration North/East/Down acceleration in meters per second squared. -- @field Wander_Angle_Rad Wander angle in radians. -- @field Magnetic_Heading Provider magnetic heading; the pinned declaration specifies no unit. -- @field Altitude_MSL Upstream altitudeMSL value, described as barometric altitude; no -- explicit unit is stated for this field. -- @field Position_Velocity_Covariance All 18 provided covariance values; the bridge does not -- estimate them. type Navigation_Response is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; Command_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Request_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Pixel_Count
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Pixel_Count (overload 2/2)
text: function Pixel_Count (Frame : Frame_Lease) return Natural; -- Closes the lease and invalidates its borrowed payload, also on provider-release failure. An -- already-closed lease is a no-op. The retained buffer is returned through the published -- Buffer release operation when successful. Provider failure or exception makes ownership -- uncertain: the bridge deliberately retains the provider graph, exact buffer object and host -- memory to avoid unsafe reuse or unload. This is not successful buffer release; the failed -- release is not automatically retried. Explicit Close reports failure, whereas automatic -- finalization suppresses it and can retain resources for safety. Final-child closure may -- perform deferred channel cleanup. Do not race Close with a borrow, copy, or another -- operation on this same lease. -- @param Frame Lease consumed by this operation; its payload count becomes zero. -- @exception Provider_Error Native buffer release or deferred cleanup did not complete safely. function Pixel_Count (Frame : Frame_Lease) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Submit_Camera_Command
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Submit_Camera_Command
text: function Submit_Camera_Command (Object : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream; Command : AMS.MEL.IR.Camera.Camera_Command) return AMS.MEL.IR.Camera.Camera_Request; -- Waits for a cached terminal result without consuming the request. Timeout is not -- cancellation; later waits may obtain completion and repeated terminal waits return the -- cached result. Requires an open request in practice; closed handles and provider/native -- failures raise Provider Error. Public request Close must not race Wait. Cleanup failure -- after provider completion is reported as a failure rather than a false successful response. -- Rejection text is copied completely using a checked second cached read when needed; invalid -- UTF-8 or embedded NUL receives a native fallback description. -- @param Request Open navigation request to observe. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls. -- @return Owned successful response or explicit provider rejection. -- @exception Timeout_Error Request has not completed within the wait; remains open and -- pending. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed request, provider exception, invalid result, or -- native/deferred-cleanup failure. function Submit_Camera_Command (Object : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream; Command : AMS.MEL.IR.Camera.Camera_Command) return AMS.MEL.IR.Camera.Camera_Request;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Submit_Navigation_Report
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Submit_Navigation_Report
text: function Submit_Navigation_Report (Object : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream; Report : Navigation_Report) return Navigation_Request; -- Limited owner of a public asynchronous navigation request handle. A private completion -- worker consumes the provider future once and caches its terminal result. Pending work -- retains the underlying stream, Session and provider code after public Close. A future that -- never completes can retain those resources indefinitely. Finalization closes the public -- handle without raising; neither it nor explicit Close cancels provider work. function Submit_Navigation_Report (Object : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream; Report : Navigation_Report) return Navigation_Request;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.System_Time_NS
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.System_Time_NS (overload 1/2)
text: function System_Time_NS (Value : Full_Frame) return Long_Long_Integer; -- A control-only attachment raises Provider_Error with a control-only -- diagnostic; enabling that channel never makes sample access available. -- Receives a complete frame by copying header metadata and the entire pixel payload into -- Ada-owned storage, then closing the temporary native snapshot before return. The result -- survives stream, Session and provider closure. Pixels makes another independent copy. This -- exposes more metadata than legacy IR Receive, but performs no pixel decoding or conversion. -- Only Mono8 single-band nonempty dimensions and validated host-buffer spans are accepted; -- malformed provider frames are discarded by the native callback. At most one receive/acquire -- consumer may use a stream at once. Externally serialize lifecycle operations on a shared Ada -- owner. Timeout does not stop the stream. The private snapshot cleanup helper ignores native -- release status; explicit lease Close is the reporting path for release failures. -- @param Object Image stream from which to dequeue; Start admits image callbacks. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum queue wait in milliseconds; zero polls without waiting. -- @return Complete independently owned frame and row-major payload bytes. -- @exception Timeout_Error No frame became available within the wait. -- @exception Stream_Stopped Stream has logically stopped with no frame available. -- @exception Provider_Error Native/provider failure, closed stream, or invalid converted -- metadata/span. function System_Time_NS (Value : Full_Frame) return Long_Long_Integer;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.System_Time_NS
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Image.System_Time_NS (overload 2/2)
text: function System_Time_NS (Frame : Frame_Lease) return Long_Long_Integer; -- Allocates independent Ada storage and copies exactly the lease payload byte count. Bounds -- are one through the payload byte count, including the empty one-through-zero case. The -- result survives lease, stream and Session closure. Requires an open lease and borrows internally through -- the synchronous pixel borrow; its closed-handle and invalid-address failure rules also apply. -- @param Frame Open lease whose bytes are copied; do not race Close. -- @return Independent row-major payload-byte array, with no decoding or conversion. function System_Time_NS (Frame : Frame_Lease) return Long_Long_Integer;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Close
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Close (overload 2/2)
text: procedure Close (Request : in out Instrumentation_Request); -- Waits for a terminal result without consuming the request. Timeout is not cancellation; -- later Wait may complete, and repeated terminal waits return the identical cached result. -- Explicit provider rejection is returned separately from provider exceptions or native -- failures. Rejection text is recovered completely by a checked cached retry if necessary; -- invalid UTF-8/NUL text receives a native fallback. Close must not race Wait on the same -- request. -- @param Request Open public instrumentation request. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls. -- @return Owned report or explicit rejection. -- @exception Timeout_Error Future has not completed within the wait; request remains open. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed request, provider exception, invalid terminal result, or -- native/deferred-cleanup failure. procedure Close (Request : in out Instrumentation_Request);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Is_Open (overload 1/2)
text: function Is_Open (Channel : Instrumentation_Channel) return Boolean; -- Attaches and verifies an InstrumentationChannel and its advertised instrumentation -- capability; no owner escapes on failure. This interface is conditionally required only for -- providers supporting instrumentation. Capabilities, common services and metadata -- registration are available while attached; instrumentation Submit requires explicit Enable. -- Native configuration text must be UTF-8 without embedded NUL. Failure cleanup retains the -- native graph if detach is uncertain. -- @param Parent Open IR Session supplying the child provider channel. -- @param Config Complete typed attachment configuration. -- @return Attached, not yet enabled, limited channel owner. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed Session, invalid text, provider attach/type/capability -- failure or native failure. function Is_Open (Channel : Instrumentation_Channel) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Is_Open (overload 2/2)
text: function Is_Open (Request : Instrumentation_Request) return Boolean; -- Submits the supplied command only while the typed channel is enabled; does not implicitly -- Enable. Copies command values synchronously and returns a request handle, not proof of -- acceptance or completion. The native provider send runs outside the lifecycle lock so -- synchronous metadata callbacks can proceed. A pending request retains provider resources -- independently after public channel and Session closure. -- @param Channel Enabled typed instrumentation owner; serialize application lifecycle -- operations. -- @param Command Command identifier and one of the two supported priority levels. -- @return Open limited request handle for later Wait. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed/not-enabled channel, provider send exception or native -- failure. -- @exception Resource_Exhausted Shared asynchronous-request admission limit reached. function Is_Open (Request : Instrumentation_Request) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.Counters
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.Counters
text: function Counters (Stream : Metadata_Channel) return Metadata_Counters; -- Saturating native callback counters, not counts of successful Ada receives. -- @field Events_Received Observed callback entries, including entries after consumption -- becomes inactive. -- @field Events_Dropped_Queue_Full Valid incoming reports dropped when the bounded queue is -- full; queued reports are not evicted. -- @field Malformed_Or_Unsupported Null reports or unknown priority values rejected by callback -- validation; copying/allocation exceptions instead fail the metadata stream. function Counters (Stream : Metadata_Channel) return Metadata_Counters;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.Is_Open
text: function Is_Open (Stream : Metadata_Channel) return Boolean; -- Registers the conditionally required report callback once per attached or enabled channel, -- including failed attempts. Provider registration can invoke the callback synchronously. A -- failed registration publishes no metadata owner but retains inactive callback state as -- required for safety; upstream provides no unregister operation. Queue ordering follows -- successful enqueue, not timestamps or concurrent callback entry order. -- @param Channel Attached or enabled typed instrumentation owner. -- @param Queue_Capacity Maximum queued reports; defaults to sixteen. -- @return Limited public polling owner. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed/ineligible channel, repeated registration, provider -- registration failure/exception or native failure. function Is_Open (Stream : Metadata_Channel) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.Metadata_Channel
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.Metadata_Channel
text: type Metadata_Channel is limited private; -- Bounded owned polling of instrumentation report callbacks. Native callbacks validate and -- copy the four-field report into a drop-incoming queue without calling Ada. Receive returns -- independent Ada values. Upstream has no callback unregister operation; public consumption -- closure is distinct from physical provider-channel destruction. type Metadata_Channel is limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.Metadata_Counters
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.Metadata_Counters
text: type Metadata_Counters is record Events_Received, Events_Dropped_Queue_Full, Malformed_Or_Unsupported : Counter; end record; -- Dequeues a complete native copied report, copies it into an Ada-owned record and closes the -- native temporary before return. No provider pointer escapes. Queued reports can drain after -- logical typed-channel closure or callback failure; an empty inactive queue raises Stream -- Stopped, and an empty failed queue raises Provider Error. -- @param Stream Open polling owner; serialize Receive and Close on this object. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum queue wait in milliseconds; zero polls. -- @return Independent report surviving metadata, channel and Session closure. -- @exception Timeout_Error Active queue remained empty until the wait expired. -- @exception Stream_Stopped Inactive or stopped queue is empty. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed polling owner, failed callback state, invalid priority or -- native failure. type Metadata_Counters is record Events_Received, Events_Dropped_Queue_Full, Malformed_Or_Unsupported : Counter; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.Open
text: function Open (Channel : Instrumentation_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive := 16) return Metadata_Channel; -- Limited public metadata-consumption owner. Callback state belongs to the typed -- instrumentation channel, not this owner; finalization attempts non-raising consumption -- closure. Serialize operations on the same Ada object. function Open (Channel : Instrumentation_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive := 16) return Metadata_Channel;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.Receive
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.Receive
text: function Receive (Stream : Metadata_Channel; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Instrumentation_Report; -- Tests local metadata handle ownership, not callback activity or channel enablement. -- @param Stream Public metadata owner to inspect. -- @return True when its local native handle is nonnull. function Receive (Stream : Metadata_Channel; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Instrumentation_Report;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Open
text: function Open (Parent : Session; Config : Instrumentation_Config) return Instrumentation_Channel; -- Limited typed owner, initially closed. Open attaches without enabling. Native child state -- retains Session/provider lifetime after public Session closure. A common weak view does not -- keep this owner alive. Finalization attempts non-raising cleanup and can retain resources -- when detach ownership is uncertain. Externally serialize operations on a shared Ada owner. function Open (Parent : Session; Config : Instrumentation_Config) return Instrumentation_Channel;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Priority
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Priority
text: type Priority is (Normal, Debug); -- Idempotently closes the typed public owner and deactivates metadata consumption. Pending -- requests defer physical disable/detach until completion. Cleanup disables if enable was -- attempted, detaches and destroys the provider channel before draining bridge callbacks. -- Synchronous detach failure retains the owner for retry; uncertain orphaned cleanup retains -- the provider graph. Automatic finalization attempts non-raising cleanup, not guaranteed -- immediate unload. -- @param Channel Typed owner to close; serialize against other uses. -- @exception Provider_Error Disable/detach or native cleanup failure; handle may remain for -- retry. type Priority is (Normal, Debug);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Rejection_Code
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Rejection_Code
text: function Rejection_Code (Result : Instrumentation_Result) return Instrumentation_Error_Code with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected; -- Accesses the report of a terminal result. Requires Status equal to Success; enabled -- precondition checking raises Assertion Error on violation. The accessor body does not add an -- outcome check. -- @param Result Owned terminal result satisfying the declared outcome precondition. -- @return Independent four-field instrumentation report. function Rejection_Code (Result : Instrumentation_Result) return Instrumentation_Error_Code with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Report
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Report
text: function Report (Result : Instrumentation_Result) return Instrumentation_Report with Pre => Status (Result) = Success; -- Returns the terminal outcome stored in the result. -- @param Result Owned terminal instrumentation result. -- @return Success or explicit provider rejection. function Report (Result : Instrumentation_Result) return Instrumentation_Report with Pre => Status (Result) = Success;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Status
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Status
text: function Status (Result : Instrumentation_Result) return Instrumentation_Outcome; -- Ada-owned terminal report or explicit rejection. Provider exceptions, null successful -- results, unknown priority/error values and native failures raise Provider Error rather than -- becoming a normal Rejected result. Values survive request closure. function Status (Result : Instrumentation_Result) return Instrumentation_Outcome;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Submit
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Submit
text: function Submit (Channel : Instrumentation_Channel; Command : Instrumentation_Level_Command) return Instrumentation_Request; -- Limited public asynchronous-request owner. A private completion worker consumes the provider -- future once and caches the result while retaining the native channel, Session and provider -- code. Public request Close and finalization do not cancel provider work; a never-completing -- future can retain resources indefinitely. Finalization is non-raising. function Submit (Channel : Instrumentation_Channel; Command : Instrumentation_Level_Command) return Instrumentation_Request;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Wait
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Wait
text: function Wait (Request : Instrumentation_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Instrumentation_Result; -- Tests public request handle ownership, not future readiness. -- @param Request Request owner to inspect. -- @return True while the local native request handle is nonnull. function Wait (Request : Instrumentation_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Instrumentation_Result;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Is_Open
text: function Is_Open (Object : Image_Stream) return Boolean; -- Attach an image channel using the advertised Mono8 single-band capability. -- Opening does not start image reception; call Start explicitly. -- @param Parent Open IR Session; serialize this call against parent closure. -- @param Config Channel/platform/location and bounded host-storage settings. -- @return Limited owner of an attached, not yet started, image stream. -- @exception Provider_Error Parent is closed or native validation, capability -- selection, acquisition or attachment fails, including invalid UTF-8 text. function Is_Open (Object : Image_Stream) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion.Forward_Right_Down
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion.Forward_Right_Down
text: subtype Forward_Right_Down is AMS.MEL.IR.Optical_Distortion_Map.Forward_Right_Down; -- The canonical Image quaternion record, components X, Y, Z and W from upstream -- getQuaternionX/Y/Z/W in that order. Here it is the line-of-sight rotation in the -- upstream navigation coordinate frame (North/East/Down relative to wander North). It is -- not normalized and its sign is not canonicalized: q and -q stay distinct values. subtype Forward_Right_Down is AMS.MEL.IR.Optical_Distortion_Map.Forward_Right_Down;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion.Line_Of_Sight_Value
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion.Line_Of_Sight_Value
text: type Line_Of_Sight_Value is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer := 0; Q_XYZW : Quaternion := (others => 0.0); PQR_RPS : Forward_Right_Down := (others => 0.0); end record; -- The canonical ForwardRightDown record, components Forward, Right and Down from upstream -- getForward/getRight/getDown. Here it holds rotation rates about the image coordinate frame -- axes, in radians per second; rates are not clamped or rescaled. type Line_Of_Sight_Value is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer := 0; Q_XYZW : Quaternion := (others => 0.0); PQR_RPS : Forward_Right_Down := (others => 0.0); end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion.Quaternion
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion.Quaternion
text: subtype Quaternion is AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Quaternion; -- The provider answered NotSupported for the LineOfSightQuaternion registration, so it does -- not provide quaternion line of sight. The other Image metadata owners of the same stream -- are unaffected. subtype Quaternion is AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Quaternion;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Offset_X_M
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Offset_X_M

label: AMS.MEL.IR.Open_Image_Control

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Open_Image_Stream
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Open_Image_Stream
text: function Open_Image_Stream (Parent : Session; Config : Image_Config) return Image_Stream; -- Limited controlled owner of a legacy native image stream. Default state -- is closed. name: AMS.MEL.IR.Optical_Distortion_Map.Append_FRD
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Optical_Distortion_Map.Append_FRD
text: procedure Append_FRD (Value : in out Map_Value; Sample : Forward_Right_Down); -- Build an owned map with every scalar set exactly as given and both collections empty. -- Values are stored unchanged; no consistency between them is checked or assumed. -- @param Width Forward-map sample count across. -- @param Height Forward-map sample count down. -- @param Right_Size Backward-map sample count in the right direction. -- @param Down_Size Backward-map sample count in the down direction. -- @param Pixels_Per_ODM Pixels per distortion-map sample. -- @param Right_Min Right direction-cosine minimum extent. -- @param Right_Max Right direction-cosine maximum extent. -- @param Down_Min Down direction-cosine minimum extent. -- @param Down_Max Down direction-cosine maximum extent. -- @return Owned map with empty FRD and RowCol collections. procedure Append_FRD (Value : in out Map_Value; Sample : Forward_Right_Down);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Optical_Distortion_Map.Append_RowCol
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Optical_Distortion_Map.Append_RowCol
text: procedure Append_RowCol (Value : in out Map_Value; Sample : Row_Column); -- Append a copy of one FRD sample at the end, preserving order and duplicates. The RowCol -- collection is unchanged. -- @param Value Destination map. -- @param Sample Sample copied to the end of the FRD collection only. procedure Append_RowCol (Value : in out Map_Value; Sample : Row_Column);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.As_Channel
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.As_Channel
text: function As_Channel (Channel : Scheduling_Channel) return AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.View; -- Copy provider capabilities while Attached or Enabled. Task_Schedule_Depth -- is reported verbatim; zero is a valid mode in which the application manages -- task priority and does not mean Scheduling is unsupported. A closed/failed -- lifecycle or conversion failure raises a provider error. -- @param Channel Eligible Scheduling owner, externally serialized against Close. -- @return Owned snapshot valid after channel, Session and provider closure. function As_Channel (Channel : Scheduling_Channel) return AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.View;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Capabilities
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Capabilities
text: function Capabilities (Channel : Scheduling_Channel) return AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Channel_Capability; -- Explicitly call the inherited Channel enable on an Attached owner; an -- already Enabled owner is idempotent. Provider refusal or exception raises -- a provider error and marks failure; retrying Enable does not recover it. -- Enabling does not submit, queue or schedule any task. -- @param Channel Open Attached or already Enabled owner; serialize owner operations. function Capabilities (Channel : Scheduling_Channel) return AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Channel_Capability;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Close
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Close
text: procedure Close (Channel : in out Scheduling_Channel); -- Allocate a weak common view (KeepAlive, CommsTest, Capabilities) without -- changing lifecycle. Closing the view leaves this owner intact; closing -- this owner makes later view operations fail. Admitted common requests -- retain their own lifetime and use Scheduling-only request accounting. -- @param Channel Open Scheduling owner to reference weakly. -- @return Weak common view; its handle presence does not prove target existence. procedure Close (Channel : in out Scheduling_Channel);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Create_Config
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Create_Config

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Enable
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Enable
text: procedure Enable (Channel : in out Scheduling_Channel); -- Test local handle presence, not lifecycle eligibility or provider support. -- @param Channel Scheduling owner to inspect without provider access. -- @return True for a present native handle, even if lifecycle has failed. procedure Enable (Channel : in out Scheduling_Channel);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Is_Open
text: function Is_Open (Channel : Scheduling_Channel) return Boolean; -- Require an open Session that publishes the Scheduling category, attach -- once with ChannelType Scheduling (value 3), and verify the concrete -- SchedulingChannel interface and its advertised category. Configuration -- text is validated natively. Failure raises a provider error and no owner -- escapes; an ownership-uncertain incompatible attachment stays retained. -- @param Parent Open Session whose native graph is retained by the child. -- @param Config Owned attachment values copied before provider use. -- @return Attached, not Enabled, Scheduling owner. function Is_Open (Channel : Scheduling_Channel) return Boolean;

Malformed counts null -- payloads, unknown Task/TaskCompStatus values (even while full) and allocation failures. -- @param Stream Open consumption owner. -- @return Received, queue-full dropped and malformed counters. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed stream or native query failure. procedure Close (Stream : in out Task_Executing_Stream);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Execute_Task_Ack
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Execute_Task_Ack
text: type Execute_Task_Ack is record Command_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; Request_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; end record; -- The provider answered NotSupported for the conditional ExecuteTaskAck registration. -- The Scheduling owner and its inherited common Channel services are unaffected. type Execute_Task_Ack is record Command_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; Request_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Execute_Task_Ack_Counters
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Execute_Task_Ack_Counters
text: function Execute_Task_Ack_Counters (Stream : Execute_Task_Ack_Stream) return Metadata_Counters; -- Dequeue in successful-enqueue order; copy both identifiers and release the native event -- before returning, including on conversion failure. Queued events drain after Scheduling -- Close, even while common requests defer physical teardown; terminal cleanup failure is -- reported only after that queue drains. Reception is not execution completion or success. -- @param Stream Open metadata consumption owner. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum queue wait in milliseconds; zero polls, not cancellation. -- @return Fully Ada-owned acknowledgement, valid after all owners and the provider close. -- @exception Timeout_Error Active queue remained empty until the wait expired. -- @exception Stream_Stopped Inactive or stopped queue is empty. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed stream, failed provider cleanup or native failure. function Execute_Task_Ack_Counters (Stream : Execute_Task_Ack_Stream) return Metadata_Counters;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Execute_Task_Ack_Stream
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Execute_Task_Ack_Stream
text: type Execute_Task_Ack_Stream is limited private; -- Saturating callback counters, not successful Ada Receive calls. -- @field Events_Received Callback entries, including inactive callbacks and rejected events. -- @field Events_Dropped_Queue_Full Valid incoming events dropped without snapshot allocation -- because the bounded queue is full. Already queued events are retained. -- @field Malformed_Or_Unsupported Null payloads (even while full) and callback allocation or -- copy failures. A failed event is rejected atomically; later reception can recover. type Execute_Task_Ack_Stream is limited private;

label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Is_Operational

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Metadata_Counters
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Metadata_Counters
text: type Metadata_Counters is record Events_Received : AMS.MEL.IR.Counter; Events_Dropped_Queue_Full : AMS.MEL.IR.Counter; Malformed_Or_Unsupported : AMS.MEL.IR.Counter; end record; -- Complete Ada-owned acknowledgement, independent of the native event and provider graph. -- @field Command_ID All 32 bits of upstream getCommandID(), including zero and high bits. -- @field Request_ID All 32 bits of upstream getReqId(), independent of Command_ID. Zero, -- unequal and duplicate identifiers are all valid; this is not a completion status. type Metadata_Counters is record Events_Received : AMS.MEL.IR.Counter; Events_Dropped_Queue_Full : AMS.MEL.IR.Counter; Malformed_Or_Unsupported : AMS.MEL.IR.Counter; end record;

Explicit Close is preferred; finalization -- attempts non-raising cleanup. Serialize operations and Close on one stream externally. function Open_Task_Executing (Channel : Scheduling_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive) return Task_Executing_Stream;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Receive_Execute_Task_Ack
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Receive_Execute_Task_Ack
text: function Receive_Execute_Task_Ack (Stream : Execute_Task_Ack_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Execute_Task_Ack; -- Register exactly the ExecuteTaskAck overload once per Attached or Enabled Scheduling -- channel, including failed attempts. No foundation operation implicitly registers it. -- Registration runs without bridge locks and may deliver synchronously. No unregister -- exists; after failure retained callback state is inactive. No task is submitted. -- @param Channel Attached or Enabled Scheduling owner, serialized against its closure. -- @param Queue_Capacity Maximum number of events in the bounded drop-incoming queue. -- @return Independent limited metadata consumption owner. -- @exception Not_Supported Provider answered NotSupported. -- @exception Provider_Error Ineligible/closed owner, second attempt, other refusal, provider -- exception or native allocation failure. function Receive_Execute_Task_Ack (Stream : Execute_Task_Ack_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Execute_Task_Ack;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Receive_Task_Executing
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Receive_Task_Executing
text: function Receive_Task_Executing (Stream : Task_Executing_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Task_Executing_Report; -- Register exactly the TaskExecutingRep overload once per Attached or Enabled Scheduling -- channel, including failed attempts. Opening never registers ExecuteTaskAck, and opening an -- ExecuteTaskAck stream never registers this callback; either order is valid. Registration -- runs without bridge locks and may deliver synchronously. No unregister exists. -- @param Channel Attached or Enabled Scheduling owner, serialized against its closure. -- @param Queue_Capacity Maximum number of reports in the bounded drop-incoming queue. -- @return Independent limited metadata consumption owner. -- @exception Not_Supported Provider answered NotSupported. -- @exception Provider_Error Ineligible/closed owner, second attempt, other refusal, provider -- exception or native allocation failure. function Receive_Task_Executing (Stream : Task_Executing_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Task_Executing_Report;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Task_Executing_Counters
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Task_Executing_Counters
text: function Task_Executing_Counters (Stream : Task_Executing_Stream) return Metadata_Counters; -- Dequeue in successful-enqueue order, convert all ten fields with checked enumerations and -- release the native event before returning, including on conversion failure. Reports with -- an unknown Task or TaskCompStatus never reach the queue. Queued reports drain after -- Scheduling Close; terminal cleanup failure is reported only after that queue drains. -- @param Stream Open metadata consumption owner. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum queue wait in milliseconds; zero polls, not cancellation. -- @return Fully Ada-owned report, valid after all owners and the provider close. -- @exception Timeout_Error Active queue remained empty until the wait expired. -- @exception Stream_Stopped Inactive or stopped queue is empty. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed stream, failed provider cleanup, out-of-domain native -- enumeration or native failure. function Task_Executing_Counters (Stream : Task_Executing_Stream) return Metadata_Counters;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Task_Executing_Report
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Task_Executing_Report
text: type Task_Executing_Report is record Command_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; Activity_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; Request_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; Current_Task : Task_Kind := No_Task; Estimated_Duration_NS : Interfaces.Integer_64 := 0; Track_ID : Interfaces.Integer_32 := 0; Previous_Activity_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; Previous_Request_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; Previous_Task : Task_Kind := No_Task; Previous_Task_Status : Task_Completion_Status := Status_No_Task; end record; type Task_Executing_Report is record Command_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; Activity_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; Request_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; Current_Task : Task_Kind := No_Task; Estimated_Duration_NS : Interfaces.Integer_64 := 0; Track_ID : Interfaces.Integer_32 := 0; Previous_Activity_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; Previous_Request_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0; Previous_Task : Task_Kind := No_Task; Previous_Task_Status : Task_Completion_Status := Status_No_Task; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Task_Executing_Stream
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Task_Executing_Stream
text: type Task_Executing_Stream is limited private; -- Complete Ada-owned report of all ten upstream getters, independent of the native event and -- provider graph. Defaults equal the upstream defaults. Current and previous values are -- independent; no relationship between them is inferred or enforced. -- @field Command_ID All 32 bits of upstream getCommandID(). -- @field Activity_ID All 32 bits of upstream getActivityId() for the current task. -- @field Request_ID All 32 bits of upstream getReqId() for the current task. -- @field Current_Task Upstream getTask(), the reported currently executing task kind. -- @field Estimated_Duration_NS Exact signed upstream getEstimatedDuration().count() in -- nanoseconds; never converted to seconds, Duration or a time point. Negative is preserved. -- @field Track_ID Signed upstream getTrackId(); negative and zero values are preserved. -- @field Previous_Activity_ID All 32 bits of upstream getPrevActivityId(). -- @field Previous_Request_ID All 32 bits of upstream getPrevReqId(). -- @field Previous_Task Upstream getPrevTask(), the reported previous task kind. -- @field Previous_Task_Status Upstream getPrevTaskStatus(): the previous task's reported -- completion status, not a status of Current_Task. type Task_Executing_Stream is limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Task_Kind
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling.Metadata.Task_Kind
text: type Task_Kind is (No_Task, Abort_Task, IRST_Camera_Calibration, Camera_Calibration, IRST_Boresight, Idle, IRST_Scan, IRST_Position, IRST_Single_Target_Track, IRST_Multiple_Target_Track, IRST_Update, Reserved_1, Reserved_2, Reserved_3, Reserved_4, Reserved_5, Reserved_6); -- Idempotently deactivate consumption, without unregistering, closing the Scheduling owner -- or waiting for callback quiescence. Already returned Ada values remain owned. Physical -- teardown retains the provider graph until in-flight bridge callbacks have drained. -- @param Stream Metadata owner to close. -- @exception Provider_Error Native closure failed. -- IRMEL-ADA-013: opt-in reception of the pinned @RequiredIfIRSTTrackTasking -- TaskExecutingRep callback, independent of ExecuteTaskAck. A report describes what the -- provider says is executing; it is not a task request and no task is executed here. type Task_Kind is (No_Task, Abort_Task, IRST_Camera_Calibration, Camera_Calibration, IRST_Boresight, Idle, IRST_Scan, IRST_Position, IRST_Single_Target_Track, IRST_Multiple_Target_Track, IRST_Update, Reserved_1, Reserved_2, Reserved_3, Reserved_4, Reserved_5, Reserved_6);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Start
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Start
text: procedure Start (Object : in out Image_Stream); -- Attach for Image commands, capabilities, common Channel operations and -- metadata, even when all advertised layout values are zero. Reuses the -- limited Image_Stream owner and its Stop/Close, pending-request and callback -- retention rules. Explicit Close is preferred to non-raising finalization. -- Start enables the channel only: no buffer factory, sample allocation or -- registration occurs. Enable is not evidence that acquisition has begun. -- Both Receive APIs (including frame leases) raise Provider_Error with a -- control-only diagnostic; no pixel view can be obtained from this owner. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed parent, invalid metadata or failed attach. procedure Start (Object : in out Image_Stream);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.IRST_Track_Report
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.IRST_Track_Report
text: type IRST_Track_Report is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; Activity_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Measured_NED : North_East_Down; Measured_Intensity : Long_Float; Measured_SNR : Long_Float; Filtered_NED : North_East_Down; Filtered_Intensity : Long_Float; Filtered_SNR : Long_Float; Range_M : Long_Float; Range_Error_M : Long_Float; Spatial_Extent_Rad : Long_Float; Track_Quality : Long_Float; Clutter : Long_Float; Age_NS : Long_Long_Integer; State : IRST_Track_State; Mode : IRST_Track_Mode; end record; -- Copied north/east/down components independent of Image package types. -- Pinned directional/report declarations establish no component units or -- normalization; do not treat this as an automatically transformed position. -- @field North Reported north component without bridge conversion. -- @field East Reported east component without bridge conversion. -- @field Down Reported down component without bridge conversion. -- Complete IRSTTrackReport. Every upstream getter is represented exactly -- once and no floating-point value is clamped or normalized. type IRST_Track_Report is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; Activity_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Measured_NED : North_East_Down; Measured_Intensity : Long_Float; Measured_SNR : Long_Float; Filtered_NED : North_East_Down; Filtered_Intensity : Long_Float; Filtered_SNR : Long_Float; Range_M : Long_Float; Range_Error_M : Long_Float; Spatial_Extent_Rad : Long_Float; Track_Quality : Long_Float; Clutter : Long_Float; Age_NS : Long_Long_Integer; State : IRST_Track_State; Mode : IRST_Track_Mode; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.IRST_Track_State
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.IRST_Track_State
text: type IRST_Track_State is (State_Idle, Detected, Coast, Dropped); -- Stop public admission and close the owner without cancelling futures. -- Physical disable/detach waits for all pending update, system-response and -- common requests. Disable is attempted if enabling was attempted; detach -- failure retains the graph/handle for retry. Disable failure can raise a -- provider error even after successful detach consumed the handle. Provider -- channel destruction, then callback-count drain, establishes quiescence; -- disable return alone does not. Orphaned unsafe cleanup retains resources. -- @param Channel Track owner to close; serialize against its public operations. -- Upstream IrstTrackState. The Idle literal is prefixed because -- IrstTrackMode declares an Idle of its own in the same scope. type IRST_Track_State is (State_Idle, Detected, Coast, Dropped);

Positive behavior is mock-only. -- @param Parent Open Session whose native graph is retained by the child. -- @param Config Owned attachment values copied before provider use. -- @return Attached, not Enabled, Track owner. function Is_Open (Channel : Track_Channel) return Boolean;

This is an owned Ada -- 2-D value; the flat row-major C array is mapped to it explicitly. subtype Background_Index is Positive range 1 .. 3;
