Count meaning differs between fixed-array and PreProc messages. -- @field Number_Of_COs Declared unsigned 16-bit candidate count; fixed-array messages use this prefix, PreProc vectors have an independent length. -- @field Stack_Frame_Index Zero-based current frame index within a stack sequence. -- @field CFAR Upstream binary32 average per-pixel false alarm rate, FA/pixel; retained as Float without widening or algorithm inference. -- @field Validity_Flag_Bitfield Opaque unsigned 16-bit validity for stack index/CFAR; bit definitions are not invented. -- @field TOV_UTC_NS Signed UTC-named time-of-validity nanosecond count; no more specific epoch is established. -- Complete CandidateObject. No floating-point value is clamped or -- normalized. type Candidate_Object is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; Detection_Category : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Sensor_Index : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Subpixel : Row_Column; Intensity : Long_Float; Sensor_Relative_Unit : Directional; Signal_To_Interference_Ratio : Long_Float; Signal_To_Noise_Ratio : Long_Float; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Candidate_Object_Header
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Candidate_Object_Header
text: type Candidate_Object_Header is record Number_Of_COs : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; Stack_Frame_Index : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; CFAR : Float; Validity_Flag_Bitfield : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; TOV_UTC_NS : Long_Long_Integer; end record; -- Copied geometry for an extended high-intensity object. Upstream defines -- boundary positions as zero-based but does not establish inclusive/exclusive -- edge arithmetic here; no geometry consistency check is performed. -- @field Kind Provider hot-region category. -- @field Size Number of pixels making up the region, unsigned 16-bit. -- @field Top Top pixel position, zero-based unsigned 16-bit. -- @field Left Left pixel position, zero-based unsigned 16-bit. -- @field Right Right pixel position, zero-based unsigned 16-bit. -- @field Bottom Bottom pixel position, zero-based unsigned 16-bit. -- Complete CandidateObjectHeader. CFAR is upstream binary32 and is kept as -- Float; it is deliberately not widened. The validity bitfield is carried -- verbatim and is deliberately not decoded. type Candidate_Object_Header is record Number_Of_COs : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; Stack_Frame_Index : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; CFAR : Float; Validity_Flag_Bitfield : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; TOV_UTC_NS : Long_Long_Integer; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Candidate_Object_Message
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Candidate_Object_Message
text: type Candidate_Object_Message is private; -- Complete owned candidate detection, without numeric normalization. -- @field System_Time_NS Time of validity in signed nanoseconds, without an established epoch. -- @field Detection_Category Bitfield identifying waveband temporal depth; copied without invented bit definitions. -- @field Sensor_Index Unsigned index indicating sensor position, not an Ada vector index. -- @field Subpixel Subpixel column/row location, with no inferred pixel origin. -- @field Intensity Merged candidate intensity; units/calibration unspecified. -- @field Sensor_Relative_Unit Detection line-of-sight unit-vector report in sensor-relative xyz; not renormalized. -- @field Signal_To_Interference_Ratio SIR scalar; no linear-versus-dB convention established. -- @field Signal_To_Noise_Ratio SNR scalar; no scale conversion or normalization performed. -- Wholly Ada-owned CandidateObjectMessage. The variable-size hot-region -- and candidate collections are copied out of the native event before that -- event is closed, so no native pointer, native span, or provider storage -- is ever exposed. -- -- Exactly numberOfCOs candidate objects are present: the upstream fixed -- 900-entry array is exposed only through its meaningful prefix. type Candidate_Object_Message is private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Candidate_Object_PreProc
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Candidate_Object_PreProc
text: type Candidate_Object_PreProc is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; Detection_Category : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Sensor_Index : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Subpixel : Row_Column; Intensity : Long_Float; Sensor_Relative_Unit : Directional; Signal_To_Interference_Ratio : Long_Float; Signal_To_Noise_Ratio : Long_Float; Candidate_Object_With_Background : Candidate_Background; Clutter : Long_Float; Candidate_Object_Quality : Long_Float; Sir_Delta : Long_Float; Inertial_State : Sensor_Inertial_State; Edge : Boolean; Az_Sigma : Long_Float; El_Sigma : Long_Float; Background_Normalizer : Long_Float; end record; -- Owned 3x3 signed 16-bit intensity patch around a candidate. Native row-major -- nine-sample storage is mapped explicitly to Ada row/column indices; signed -- values survive without unsigned conversion or intensity rescaling. -- Complete CandidateObjectPreProc. Every published getter is represented -- exactly once. No floating-point value is clamped or normalized: -- Candidate_Object_Quality is documented upstream as "0 to 1" but the -- published setter enforces nothing, and the sensor-relative unit vector -- is not renormalized. Detection_Category is an upstream bitfield and is -- deliberately not decoded. Each entry carries its OWN nested inertial -- state, distinct from the message-level one. type Candidate_Object_PreProc is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; Detection_Category : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Sensor_Index : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Subpixel : Row_Column; Intensity : Long_Float; Sensor_Relative_Unit : Directional; Signal_To_Interference_Ratio : Long_Float; Signal_To_Noise_Ratio : Long_Float; Candidate_Object_With_Background : Candidate_Background; Clutter : Long_Float; Candidate_Object_Quality : Long_Float; Sir_Delta : Long_Float; Inertial_State : Sensor_Inertial_State; Edge : Boolean; Az_Sigma : Long_Float; El_Sigma : Long_Float; Background_Normalizer : Long_Float; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Candidate_Object_PreProc_At
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Candidate_Object_PreProc_At
text: function Candidate_Object_PreProc_At (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message; Index : Positive) return Candidate_Object_PreProc; -- Count the actual copied PreProc vector, not the header's candidate count. -- @param Message Owned PreProc message to inspect. -- @return Actual vector length, even when header count differs. function Candidate_Object_PreProc_At (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message; Index : Positive) return Candidate_Object_PreProc;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Candidate_Object_PreProc_Count
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Candidate_Object_PreProc_Count
text: function Candidate_Object_PreProc_Count (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message) return Natural; -- Copy a region; index beyond vector length raises a constraint error. -- @param Message Owned PreProc message to inspect. -- @param Index One-based hot-region position, not a pixel coordinate. -- @return Independent hot-region value. function Candidate_Object_PreProc_Count (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message
text: type Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message is private; -- Complete owned preprocessed detection. No statistical estimation, -- confidence calibration, vector normalization or score clamping is done. -- @field System_Time_NS Time of validity in signed nanoseconds; epoch unspecified. -- @field Detection_Category Opaque waveband temporal-depth bitfield, all 32 bits preserved. -- @field Sensor_Index Unsigned sensor-position index, not an Ada vector position. -- @field Subpixel Subpixel column/row location with no invented pixel origin. -- @field Intensity Merged candidate intensity with unspecified physical units. -- @field Sensor_Relative_Unit Sensor-relative line-of-sight xyz unit-vector report, not renormalized. -- @field Signal_To_Interference_Ratio SIR scalar without an established dB/linear convention. -- @field Signal_To_Noise_Ratio SNR scalar without scale conversion. -- @field Candidate_Object_With_Background Exact signed 16-bit 3x3 intensity patch around this candidate. -- @field Clutter Provider clutter scalar, with no established numeric range. -- @field Candidate_Object_Quality Upstream documents zero to one, but setters/bridge do not enforce or clamp it. -- @field Sir_Delta Signal intensity from threshold, reporting candidate sensitivity; units unspecified. -- @field Inertial_State This entry's own navigation snapshot, distinct from the message-level state. -- @field Edge True when detection is near an obscuration, as reported by the provider. -- @field Az_Sigma Azimuth-measurement uncertainty scalar; unit/confidence convention unspecified. -- @field El_Sigma Elevation-measurement uncertainty scalar; unit/confidence convention unspecified. -- @field Background_Normalizer Background-noise statistic used for SIR, without bridge calculation. -- Wholly Ada-owned CandidateObjectPreProcMessage. The variable-size -- hot-region and PreProc collections are copied out of the native event -- before that event is closed, so no native pointer, native span, or -- provider storage is ever exposed. -- -- Unlike Candidate_Object_Message, the upstream container here is a -- std::vector that already carries its own size, and the pinned headers -- publish NO invariant requiring Number_Of_COs to equal that size. Both -- values are therefore preserved verbatim: Header reports the provider's -- Number_Of_COs and Candidate_Object_PreProc_Count reports the actual -- vector length. A mismatch is not an error here. type Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message is private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Close
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Close
text: procedure Close (Stream : in out Metadata_Channel); -- Read synchronized queue counters; closed handle/native failure raises a -- provider error. Query does not reset counts or poll provider metadata. -- @param Stream Open metadata consumer. -- @return Owned saturating counts observed at query time. procedure Close (Stream : in out Metadata_Channel);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Counters
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Counters
text: function Counters (Stream : Metadata_Channel) return Metadata_Counters; -- Shared unsigned counters saturate without wrapping. Callback receipt is -- counted before checking active consumption; totals need not sum to received. -- @field Events_Received Observed callback entries for all four supported families. -- @field Events_Dropped_Queue_Full Valid incoming events discarded when the shared queue is full. -- @field Malformed_Or_Unsupported Null/malformed/unsupported payload drops; callback exceptions instead fail the stream. function Counters (Stream : Metadata_Channel) return Metadata_Counters;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Directional
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Directional
text: type Directional is record X, Y, Z : Long_Float; end record; -- Subpixel coordinates copied from upstream RowCol, whose x is column and -- y is row. No pixel-origin convention or rounding is inferred. -- @field Row Subpixel row coordinate, preserving the provider value. -- @field Column Subpixel column coordinate, preserving the provider value. type Directional is record X, Y, Z : Long_Float; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Header
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Header (overload 1/2)
text: function Header (Message : Candidate_Object_Message) return Candidate_Object_Header; -- Owned header, navigation, hot regions and candidate prefix. Upstream fixed -- capacity is 900; declared count greater than capacity is malformed. Only -- the meaningful prefix is copied, in native order, retaining duplicates. function Header (Message : Candidate_Object_Message) return Candidate_Object_Header;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Header
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Header (overload 2/2)
text: function Header (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message) return Candidate_Object_Header; -- Owned header/navigation/hot regions and independently sized PreProc vector. -- Header count need not equal vector length; both values survive unchanged. -- Native vector order and duplicates are preserved, without a 900-entry cap. function Header (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message) return Candidate_Object_Header;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Hot_Region
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Hot_Region
text: type Hot_Region is record Kind : Hot_Region_Type; Size : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; Top : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; Left : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; Right : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; Bottom : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; end record; -- Complete HotRegion. Every published getter is represented exactly once -- and the geometry keeps its upstream 16-bit width. type Hot_Region is record Kind : Hot_Region_Type; Size : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; Top : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; Left : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; Right : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; Bottom : Interfaces.Unsigned_16; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Hot_Region_At
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Hot_Region_At (overload 1/2)
text: function Hot_Region_At (Message : Candidate_Object_Message; Index : Positive) return Hot_Region; -- Count the complete copied hot-region vector in provider order. -- @param Message Owned fixed-array candidate message to inspect. -- @return Number of hot regions, independent of candidate count. function Hot_Region_At (Message : Candidate_Object_Message; Index : Positive) return Hot_Region;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Hot_Region_At
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Hot_Region_At (overload 2/2)
text: function Hot_Region_At (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message; Index : Positive) return Hot_Region; -- Count the complete copied hot-region vector in provider order. -- @param Message Owned PreProc message to inspect. -- @return Hot-region count, independent of candidate/header counts. function Hot_Region_At (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message; Index : Positive) return Hot_Region;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Hot_Region_Count
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Hot_Region_Count (overload 1/2)
text: function Hot_Region_Count (Message : Candidate_Object_Message) return Natural; -- Copy the message-level navigation snapshot, not a borrowed provider object. -- @param Message Owned fixed-array candidate message to inspect. -- @return Independent sensor inertial state. function Hot_Region_Count (Message : Candidate_Object_Message) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Hot_Region_Count
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Hot_Region_Count (overload 2/2)
text: function Hot_Region_Count (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message) return Natural; -- Copy message-level navigation, distinct from per-entry inertial snapshots. -- @param Message Owned PreProc message to inspect. -- @return Independent message-level sensor inertial state. function Hot_Region_Count (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Hot_Region_Type
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Hot_Region_Type
text: type Hot_Region_Type is (Invalid, Flare, Solar, Mask); -- Owned sensor navigation snapshot. Quaternions and vectors are copied, not -- normalized, transformed or estimated by this bridge. -- @field System_Time_NS Signed system-time nanosecond count; epoch unspecified. -- @field Q_XYZW Quaternion from sensor to local north/east/down frame, XYZW order. -- @field Q_ECEF_XYZW Quaternion from local north/east/down to ECEF, XYZW order. -- @field Sensor_Position Sensor position in ECEF, meters. -- @field Sensor_Velocity Sensor velocity in ECEF, meters per second. -- @field Uncertainties Opaque sensor/platform navigation uncertainty values. -- Upstream HotRegionTypeEnum. It declares no MaxExclusive value, so any -- provider representation outside this range is malformed and is rejected -- natively before it can ever reach Ada. type Hot_Region_Type is (Invalid, Flare, Solar, Mask);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Inertial_State
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Inertial_State (overload 1/2)
text: function Inertial_State (Message : Candidate_Object_Message) return Sensor_Inertial_State; -- Copy the fixed candidate-message header. -- @param Message Owned fixed-array candidate message to inspect. -- @return Owned header whose count matches the copied meaningful prefix. function Inertial_State (Message : Candidate_Object_Message) return Sensor_Inertial_State;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Inertial_State
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Inertial_State (overload 2/2)
text: function Inertial_State (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message) return Sensor_Inertial_State; -- Copy the provider header without replacing its reported candidate count. -- @param Message Owned PreProc message to inspect. -- @return Header whose declared count is independent of actual vector length. function Inertial_State (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message) return Sensor_Inertial_State;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Is_Open
text: function Is_Open (Stream : Metadata_Channel) return Boolean; -- Register once while Attached or Enabled, without the Track lifecycle lock -- held across provider registration. Order: required Track report; candidate -- message only if advertised at Track Open; optional system-data request; -- optional candidate PreProc. Required report refusal and advertised candidate -- refusal fail, including NotSupported. Optional callbacks accept NotSupported -- non-fatally but other non-Success answers fail. Partial failure consumes -- the attempt and retains inactive/failed callback state without unregister; -- no public consumer escapes. Reopening after Close does not retry registration. -- @param Channel Open Attached/Enabled Track owner; serialize owner operations. -- @param Queue_Capacity Positive shared queue bound, default sixteen events. -- @return Owned queue consumer; registration failure raises a provider error. function Is_Open (Stream : Metadata_Channel) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Metadata_Channel
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Metadata_Channel
text: type Metadata_Channel is limited private; -- Four inbound callback families, not outbound RequestFor sends. Required -- Track reports, advertised candidate messages and two optional callbacks -- share one bounded drop-incoming FIFO ordered by successful enqueue, not -- provider timestamps. Native callbacks never invoke Ada. Positive behavior -- is mock-qualified; pinned Squall cannot attach this Track channel. type Metadata_Channel is limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Metadata_Counters
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Metadata_Counters
text: type Metadata_Counters is record Events_Received, Events_Dropped_Queue_Full, Malformed_Or_Unsupported : Counter; end record; -- Report-only convenience that consumes the next event. A non-report event -- raises a provider error after consumption; it is not skipped or requeued. -- Use the general event receiver for mixed kinds. Timeout/stopped/native -- failure behavior is the same as that receiver. -- @param Stream Open metadata consumer, externally serialized against Close. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; default zero polls. -- @return Owned report only when the consumed event has report kind. type Metadata_Counters is record Events_Received, Events_Dropped_Queue_Full, Malformed_Or_Unsupported : Counter; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Metadata_Event
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Metadata_Event
text: type Metadata_Event (Kind : Metadata_Kind := IRST_Track_Report_Event) is record case Kind is when IRST_Track_Report_Event => Report : IRST_Track_Report; when Request_System_Track_Data_Event => Request : Request_System_Track_Data; when Candidate_Object_Message_Event => Candidates : Candidate_Object_Message; when Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message_Event => Candidate_PreProcs : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message; end case; end record; -- Supported inbound callback alternatives, not outgoing send categories. -- @enum IRST_Track_Report_Event Conditionally required Track report callback. -- @enum Request_System_Track_Data_Event Optional inbound request for system data; no automatic response. -- @enum Candidate_Object_Message_Event Advertised candidate-message callback, required when its detection condition applies. -- @enum Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message_Event Optional inbound PreProc vector message. type Metadata_Event (Kind : Metadata_Kind := IRST_Track_Report_Event) is record case Kind is when IRST_Track_Report_Event => Report : IRST_Track_Report; when Request_System_Track_Data_Event => Request : Request_System_Track_Data; when Candidate_Object_Message_Event => Candidates : Candidate_Object_Message; when Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message_Event => Candidate_PreProcs : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message; end case; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Metadata_Kind
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Metadata_Kind
text: type Metadata_Kind is (IRST_Track_Report_Event, Request_System_Track_Data_Event, Candidate_Object_Message_Event, Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message_Event); -- Copy a PreProc entry; index beyond vector length raises a constraint error. -- @param Message Owned PreProc message to inspect. -- @param Index One-based vector position in provider order. -- @return Independent preprocessed detection including its patch and navigation. -- The implemented Track metadata event kinds. Receive_Event fails closed on -- any other native kind. type Metadata_Kind is (IRST_Track_Report_Event, Request_System_Track_Data_Event, Candidate_Object_Message_Event, Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message_Event);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Open
text: function Open (Channel : Track_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive := 16) return Metadata_Channel; -- Limited controlled owner of queue consumption, not the Track/Session or -- provider graph. Callback state survives public closure as required; -- provider-channel destruction remains the quiescence boundary. function Open (Channel : Track_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive := 16) return Metadata_Channel;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Quaternion
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Quaternion
text: type Quaternion is record X, Y, Z, W : Long_Float; end record; -- Three copied directional components; units and frame belong to the field -- using this type, not to the type itself. No normalization is performed. -- @field X First directional component. -- @field Y Second directional component. -- @field Z Third directional component. type Quaternion is record X, Y, Z, W : Long_Float; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Receive
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Receive
text: function Receive (Stream : Metadata_Channel; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return IRST_Track_Report; -- Pop the oldest successfully enqueued event of any supported kind. Queued -- values drain before stopped/failed state is reported. Empty active timeout -- raises the inherited timeout exception; stopped/inactive raises the -- inherited stopped-stream exception; native/callback/conversion failure -- raises a provider error. Native storage is released on copying exceptions. -- @param Stream Open metadata consumer, externally serialized against Close. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; default zero polls. -- @return Wholly Ada-owned discriminated event with no surviving provider references. -- Report-only convenience retained for existing callers. It raises -- Provider_Error if the next event is any non-report Track metadata kind, -- so an application that can receive more than one kind should use -- Receive_Event. Timeout_Error is inherited from AMS.MEL.IR. function Receive (Stream : Metadata_Channel; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return IRST_Track_Report;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Receive_Event
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Receive_Event
text: function Receive_Event (Stream : Metadata_Channel; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Metadata_Event; -- Discriminated wholly owned event; selecting an inactive variant component -- is governed by Ada discriminant checks, not a provider pointer lifetime. -- @field Kind Active inbound callback alternative. -- @field Report Complete owned IRST report for the report alternative. -- @field Request Owned inbound system-data request, not an outbound request handle. -- @field Candidates Owned fixed-array candidate prefix and associated metadata. -- @field Candidate_PreProcs Owned independently sized PreProc vector and associated metadata. -- Receives the next event of either kind. A positive timeout blocks until -- an event arrives, the stream stops, or the timeout expires; a zero -- timeout is a nonblocking poll. No Ada thread spins: the native adapter -- waits on a condition variable. -- Timeout_Error is inherited from AMS.MEL.IR. function Receive_Event (Stream : Metadata_Channel; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Metadata_Event;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Request_System_Track_Data
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Request_System_Track_Data
text: type Request_System_Track_Data is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; Command_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Request_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Track_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; end record; -- Test local handle presence, not channel existence or callback/queue health. -- @param Stream Metadata consumer to inspect. -- @return True when its public native handle is present, even if stopped/failed. -- Complete RequestSystemTrackData. Every value is copied verbatim from the -- published upstream getters; upstream defines no enum and no constrained -- field, so every value the provider supplies is well formed. type Request_System_Track_Data is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; Command_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Request_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Track_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Row_Column
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Row_Column
text: type Row_Column is record Row : Long_Float; Column : Long_Float; end record; -- Owned inbound request for system Track data, not an outbound submission -- or an asynchronous request owner. No response is sent automatically. -- @field System_Time_NS Signed system-time nanosecond count; epoch unspecified. -- @field Command_ID Provider command correlation identifier, all 32 bits preserved. -- @field Request_ID Provider system-data request identifier, all 32 bits preserved. -- @field Track_ID Provider numeric track identifier, not a UCI identity. -- Owned Track-facing value types for CandidateObjectMessage. They are -- deliberately independent of AMS.MEL.IR.Image so this package adds no -- Image dependency; the C ABI still reuses the one canonical native -- layout underneath. type Row_Column is record Row : Long_Float; Column : Long_Float; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Sensor_Inertial_State
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Sensor_Inertial_State
text: type Sensor_Inertial_State is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; Q_XYZW : Quaternion; Q_ECEF_XYZW : Quaternion; Sensor_Position : Directional; Sensor_Velocity : Directional; Uncertainties : Uncertainty; end record; -- Opaque upstream navigation-uncertainty values, copied without decoding -- bit meanings or assigning statistical confidence units. -- @field Sensor_Uncertainties Unsigned sensor uncertainty representation, all bits preserved. -- @field Platform_Uncertainties Unsigned platform uncertainty representation, all bits preserved. -- Complete SensorInertialState. No quaternion is normalized and no vector -- is renormalized: upstream performs no such validation. type Sensor_Inertial_State is record System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer; Q_XYZW : Quaternion; Q_ECEF_XYZW : Quaternion; Sensor_Position : Directional; Sensor_Velocity : Directional; Uncertainties : Uncertainty; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Uncertainty
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.Uncertainty
text: type Uncertainty is record Sensor_Uncertainties : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Platform_Uncertainties : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; end record; -- Copied quaternion components in upstream XYZW order, without normalization -- or an inferred rotation convention beyond the containing field's meaning. -- @field X Quaternion x component. -- @field Y Quaternion y component. -- @field Z Quaternion z component. -- @field W Quaternion w component, retained separately from xyz. type Uncertainty is record Sensor_Uncertainties : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Platform_Uncertainties : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.North_East_Down
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.North_East_Down
text: type North_East_Down is record North : Long_Float; East : Long_Float; Down : Long_Float; end record; -- Owned Track-facing NED value. Deliberately independent of -- AMS.MEL.IR.Image so this package adds no Image dependency. type North_East_Down is record North : Long_Float; East : Long_Float; Down : Long_Float; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Open
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Open
text: function Open (Parent : Session; Config : Track_Config) return Track_Channel; -- Limited controlled owner of an attached provider Track channel, retaining -- the native Session graph independently of the parent Ada Session. Pending -- updates, system responses and common requests share native request counts -- and can retain resources after public closure. Finalization is non-raising. function Open (Parent : Session; Config : Track_Config) return Track_Channel;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.Azimuth_Elevation
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.Azimuth_Elevation
text: type Azimuth_Elevation is record Azimuth_Rad : Long_Float; Elevation_Rad : Long_Float; end record; -- Optional outbound system Track data response, distinct from inbound -- system-data-request metadata. Requires Enabled Track; no automatic response -- or physical incorporation guarantee is supplied. Positive qualification is -- mock-only; pinned Squall cannot attach the Track channel. Request lifetime -- and admission are shared natively with updates and common Channel requests. -- The one canonical Track-facing azimuth/elevation value. Both components -- are radians and neither is clamped or normalized. type Azimuth_Elevation is record Azimuth_Rad : Long_Float; Elevation_Rad : Long_Float; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.Cannot_Comply

text: type Track_Covariance is record XX : Long_Float; XY : Long_Float; XZ : Long_Float; X_VX : Long_Float; X_VY : Long_Float; X_VZ : Long_Float; YY : Long_Float; YZ : Long_Float; Y_VX : Long_Float; Y_VY : Long_Float; Y_VZ : Long_Float; ZZ : Long_Float; Z_VX : Long_Float; Z_VY : Long_Float; Z_VZ : Long_Float; VX_VX : Long_Float; VX_VY : Long_Float; VX_VZ : Long_Float; VY_VY : Long_Float; VY_VZ : Long_Float; VZ_VZ : Long_Float; end record; -- Owned ECEF xyz components used separately for position and velocity. -- Pinned TrackDataUpdate specifies ECEF but not stronger component units; -- the bridge does not convert coordinates or infer a unit convention. -- @field X ECEF x component, copied through native double representation. -- @field Y ECEF y component, copied through native double representation. -- @field Z ECEF z component, copied through native double representation. -- Every published TrackDataUpdate covariance term, exactly 21 values, -- corresponding one-to-one with the C covariance record. type Track_Covariance is record XX : Long_Float; XY : Long_Float; XZ : Long_Float; X_VX : Long_Float; X_VY : Long_Float; X_VZ : Long_Float; YY : Long_Float; YZ : Long_Float; Y_VX : Long_Float; Y_VY : Long_Float; Y_VZ : Long_Float; ZZ : Long_Float; Z_VX : Long_Float; Z_VY : Long_Float; Z_VZ : Long_Float; VX_VX : Long_Float; VX_VY : Long_Float; VX_VZ : Long_Float; VY_VY : Long_Float; VY_VZ : Long_Float; VZ_VZ : Long_Float; end record;

text: type Track_Data_Update is record Platform_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Capability_UUID : UCI_ID; Activity_UUID : UCI_ID; Track_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Entity_UUID : UCI_ID; Status : Track_Status; Time_Of_Validity_Seconds : Long_Float; Time_Of_Last_Update_Seconds : Long_Float; Position_ECEF : Directional; Velocity_ECEF : Directional; Covariance : Track_Covariance; Maneuver_Probability : Long_Float; Track_Quality : Long_Float; end record; -- All 21 individually named upstream Track covariance scalars. No implicit -- packed-matrix convention, units, symmetry expansion or transformation is -- invented. This differs from Image navigation's eighteen covariance terms. -- @field XX Upstream trackCovarianceXX scalar for the X/X pair. -- @field XY Upstream trackCovarianceXY scalar for the X/Y pair. -- @field XZ Upstream trackCovarianceXZ scalar for the X/Z pair. -- @field X_VX Upstream trackCovarianceXVx scalar for the X/velocity-X pair. -- @field X_VY Upstream trackCovarianceXVy scalar for the X/velocity-Y pair. -- @field X_VZ Upstream trackCovarianceXVz scalar for the X/velocity-Z pair. -- @field YY Upstream trackCovarianceYY scalar for the Y/Y pair. -- @field YZ Upstream trackCovarianceYZ scalar for the Y/Z pair. -- @field Y_VX Upstream trackCovarianceYVx scalar for the Y/velocity-X pair. -- @field Y_VY Upstream trackCovarianceYVy scalar for the Y/velocity-Y pair. -- @field Y_VZ Upstream trackCovarianceYVz scalar for the Y/velocity-Z pair. -- @field ZZ Upstream trackCovarianceZZ scalar for the Z/Z pair. -- @field Z_VX Upstream trackCovarianceZVx scalar for the Z/velocity-X pair. -- @field Z_VY Upstream trackCovarianceZVy scalar for the Z/velocity-Y pair. -- @field Z_VZ Upstream trackCovarianceZVz scalar for the Z/velocity-Z pair. -- @field VX_VX Upstream trackCovarianceVxVx scalar for the velocity-X/velocity-X pair. -- @field VX_VY Upstream trackCovarianceVxVy scalar for the velocity-X/velocity-Y pair. -- @field VX_VZ Upstream trackCovarianceVxVz scalar for the velocity-X/velocity-Z pair. -- @field VY_VY Upstream trackCovarianceVyVy scalar for the velocity-Y/velocity-Y pair. -- @field VY_VZ Upstream trackCovarianceVyVz scalar for the velocity-Y/velocity-Z pair. -- @field VZ_VZ Upstream trackCovarianceVzVz scalar for the velocity-Z/velocity-Z pair. -- Complete TrackDataUpdate. Every upstream field is represented exactly -- once. The two times stay in upstream epoch seconds and no value is -- clamped or normalized, because the upstream setters perform no such -- validation. type Track_Data_Update is record Platform_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Capability_UUID : UCI_ID; Activity_UUID : UCI_ID; Track_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Entity_UUID : UCI_ID; Status : Track_Status; Time_Of_Validity_Seconds : Long_Float; Time_Of_Last_Update_Seconds : Long_Float; Position_ECEF : Directional; Velocity_ECEF : Directional; Covariance : Track_Covariance; Maneuver_Probability : Long_Float; Track_Quality : Long_Float; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.Track_Status
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.Track_Status
text: type Track_Status is (Create, Update, Predict, Delete); -- Outbound TrackDataUpdate under the upstream track-update condition, which -- is distinct from basic Track support. Requires Enabled Track. Positive -- execution is mock-qualified only; pinned Squall cannot attach Track. -- Bridge copies kinematics/covariance, performing no estimation, coordinate -- transformation, normalization or operational-incorporation verification. -- Upstream TrackStatus, exactly Create = 0, Update = 1, Predict = 2, and -- Delete = 3. Upstream declares no MaxExclusive value. type Track_Status is (Create, Update, Predict, Delete);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.Update_Error_Code
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.Update_Error_Code
text: type Update_Error_Code is (None, Invalid_ID, Invalid_State, Invalid_Parameters, Insufficient_Permissions, Insufficient_Resources, Insufficient_Local_Resources, Insufficient_Remote_Resources, Unsupported); -- Terminal future category, distinct from submission or physical acceptance. -- @enum Success Future produced a valid CommandStatus; its own state can still be Rejected. -- @enum Rejected Future produced an explicit upstream ErrorOr error. type Update_Error_Code is (None, Invalid_ID, Invalid_State, Invalid_Parameters, Insufficient_Permissions, Insufficient_Resources, Insufficient_Local_Resources, Insufficient_Remote_Resources, Unsupported);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.Update_Outcome
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.Update_Outcome
text: type Update_Outcome is (Success, Rejected); -- Copy reason text validated natively as UTF-8 without embedded NUL. -- @param Status Owned command-status payload to inspect. -- @return Independent text copied from immutable native cached storage. type Update_Outcome is (Success, Rejected);

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.Update_Request
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.Update_Request
text: type Update_Request is limited private; -- Copy rejection text under the declared Rejected precondition; the body -- simply returns its stored string without independently checking outcome. -- @param Result Explicitly rejected update result. -- @return Complete owned diagnostic, with consistent cached retry for long text. -- Submission requires an enabled Track_Channel. type Update_Request is limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.Update_Result
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.Update_Result
text: type Update_Result is private; -- Known upstream rejection categories mapped to native values 0..8. -- Session admission refusal is a separate exception, not one of these results. -- @enum None No-error category, value 0, preserved if present in an upstream error. -- @enum Invalid_ID Invalid identifier category, value 1. -- @enum Invalid_State Invalid state category, value 2. -- @enum Invalid_Parameters Invalid parameters category, value 3. -- @enum Insufficient_Permissions Insufficient permissions category, value 4. -- @enum Insufficient_Resources Insufficient resources category, value 5. -- @enum Insufficient_Local_Resources Insufficient local resources category, value 6. -- @enum Insufficient_Remote_Resources Insufficient remote resources category, value 7. -- @enum Unsupported Unsupported request category, value 8. -- A successful CommandStatus whose own State is Rejected is still a -- Success outcome: CommandStatus rejection is not an ErrorOr rejection. type Update_Result is private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.Wait
label: AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.Wait
text: function Wait (Request : Update_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Update_Result; -- Inspect observer-handle presence without querying future completion. -- @param Request Update observer to inspect. -- @return True when its native public handle is present, pending or terminal. function Wait (Request : Update_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Update_Result;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.UCI_ID
label: AMS.MEL.IR.UCI_ID
text: type UCI_ID is private; -- Unconstrained array of octets. Legacy received Frames own a one-based -- array of monochrome samples; borrowed views in child APIs have separate -- lifetime contracts and must not be treated as owned merely by this type. type UCI_ID is private;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.UUID
label: AMS.MEL.IR.UUID
text: type UUID is array (Natural range 0 .. 15) of Byte; -- Unsigned eight-bit octet used for UUID bytes and monochrome pixel storage. type UUID is array (Natural range 0 .. 15) of Byte;

name: AMS.MEL.IR.UUID_Value
label: AMS.MEL.IR.UUID_Value
text: function UUID_Value (ID : UCI_ID) return UUID; -- Copy binary identity and descriptive text without parsing a textual UUID. -- @param Value All sixteen UUID bytes, preserved in array order. -- @param Descriptive_Label Human-readable UTF-8 bytes copied without -- transcoding; this constructor does not validate UTF-8. -- @return Ada-owned identifier independent of the supplied label storage. -- @exception Constraint_Error The label contains an embedded NUL. function UUID_Value (ID : UCI_ID) return UUID;

name: AMS.MEL.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.Is_Open
text: function Is_Open (Object : Session) return Boolean; -- Open an IR Session with a copied asynchronous admission configuration. -- Loading, initialization and string handling are the same as Open. A bound -- limits bridge admission, not provider acceptance or completion time. -- @param Library_Path Provider shared-library path passed to the loader. -- @param Instance Provider instance passed to both factory functions. -- @param Options Session-wide admission limit; zero is unlimited. Refused -- asynchronous submissions are not queued or retried. -- @param Aperture_Config_ID Configuration identifier passed to Control init; -- the empty default is supported and its meaning is provider-defined. -- @return Limited owner of the successfully initialized provider session. -- @exception Constraint_Error Any input string contains an embedded NUL. -- @exception Provider_Error Native loading, acquisition or initialization -- fails; a failed open does not return an open Session. function Is_Open (Object : Session) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.Library_Version
label: AMS.MEL.Library_Version
text: function Library_Version (Value : Provider_Version) return Provider_Version_Number; -- Read the provider API number from a version snapshot. -- @param Value Ada-owned provider version snapshot. -- @return Unmodified provider API version number, not the bridge ABI version. function Library_Version (Value : Provider_Version) return Provider_Version_Number;

name: AMS.MEL.Open
label: AMS.MEL.Open
text: function Open (Library_Path : String; Instance : String; Aperture_Config_ID : String := "") return Session; -- Unique Ada owner of an initialized IR provider session. A default Session -- is closed. Explicit Close releases its native handle; controlled -- finalization is a non-raising cleanup fallback. Native child resources and -- outstanding requests can retain provider objects and code after closure. -- Neither closure nor finalization promises cancellation or physical -- completion of every asynchronous provider operation. function Open (Library_Path : String; Instance : String; Aperture_Config_ID : String := "") return Session;

name: AMS.MEL.Open_With_Options
label: AMS.MEL.Open_With_Options
text: function Open_With_Options (Library_Path : String; Instance : String; Options : Session_Options; Aperture_Config_ID : String := "") return Session; -- Load the provider, obtain its API manager and IR Control, and initialize -- the Control, using the default unlimited admission configuration. -- Strings are supplied as UTF-8 bytes without transcoding; this open path -- rejects embedded NUL but does not validate UTF-8. C++ ABI compatibility -- with the provider is still required behind the C facade. -- @param Library_Path Provider shared-library path passed to the loader. -- @param Instance Provider instance passed to both factory functions. -- @param Aperture_Config_ID Configuration identifier passed to Control init; -- the empty default is supported and its meaning is provider-defined. -- @return Limited owner of the successfully initialized provider session. -- @exception Constraint_Error Any input contains an embedded NUL; rejected -- before loading the provider. -- @exception Provider_Error Loading, factory lookup, object acquisition or -- initialization fails, including a non-Success initialization result. function Open_With_Options (Library_Path : String; Instance : String; Options : Session_Options; Aperture_Config_ID : String := "") return Session;

name: AMS.MEL.Provider_Version
label: AMS.MEL.Provider_Version
text: type Provider_Version is private; -- Complete unsigned 32-bit provider version number, without bridge decoding -- into major/minor fields or substitution of the facade ABI version. type Provider_Version is private;

name: AMS.MEL.Provider_Version_Number
label: AMS.MEL.Provider_Version_Number
text: type Provider_Version_Number is mod 2**32 with Size => 32; -- Admission configuration copied when a Session opens. It cannot be changed -- on that Session. A request timeout does not cancel provider work. Closing -- a request or waiting for it is not itself a capacity-release operation. -- @field Max_Async_Requests Maximum admitted outstanding asynchronous work -- across the Session's participating channels; zero means unlimited. type Provider_Version_Number is mod 2**32 with Size => 32;

name: AMS.MEL.Query_Provider_Version
label: AMS.MEL.Query_Provider_Version
text: function Query_Provider_Version (Object : Session) return Provider_Version; -- Inspect local handle presence without calling the provider. -- @param Object Session whose local ownership state is inspected. -- @return True when the Ada object holds a native session handle. This is -- not a provider-health or outstanding-work-completion test. function Query_Provider_Version (Object : Session) return Provider_Version;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.Admin_MEL
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.Admin_MEL
text: type Admin_MEL is limited private; -- Independently owned RF administrative interface, separate from DataMEL -- and C2MEL. State commands use the provider's UCI status-control interface -- and the shared Common MEL state enumeration; no separate RF state model -- is introduced. Acceptance is not evidence of a physical state transition. -- Externally serialize operations on each owner, including closure and -- finalization. This package does not provide concurrent-handle protection. type Admin_MEL is limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.Close
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.Close
text: procedure Close (Object : in out Admin_MEL); -- Obtain fresh shared UCI and status-control owners and call upstream -- StatusControl::commandState. All fifteen Common MEL representations -- 0 through 14 are accepted by bridge validation, including the unset, -- Unknown and Degraded; provider support and acceptance remain separate. -- There is no bridge transition table, status polling or completion wait. -- Closed owners, null required provider interfaces, provider exceptions or -- malformed native Boolean results raise a provider error, not False. -- @param Object Open administrative owner; externally serialize its use. -- @param State Shared MFA state command, mapped by its checked enumeration representation. -- @return Provider acceptance Boolean; False is normal rejection and True does not prove hardware transition. procedure Close (Object : in out Admin_MEL);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.Command_State
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.Command_State
text: function Command_State (Object : Admin_MEL; State : AMS.MEL.Status.MFA_State) return Boolean; -- Inspect only the local handle, without querying provider health or MFA -- state. False after Close even when shutdown failed and native resources -- remain permanently retained. -- @param Object Administrative owner whose local handle is inspected. -- @return True exactly when the owner holds a nonnull public native handle. function Command_State (Object : Admin_MEL; State : AMS.MEL.Status.MFA_State) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.Is_Open
text: function Is_Open (Object : Admin_MEL) return Boolean; -- Load the provider library and invoke only its createAdminMEL factory with -- the configuration text. Does not open or borrow a DataMEL or C2MEL. -- Embedded NUL in either input raises a constraint error before allocation -- of temporary C strings or any provider call. Temporary strings are freed -- on both normal and exceptional exits. Native loading, symbol lookup, -- allocation, null-factory-result and factory-exception failures raise -- a provider error; no open owner is returned on those failures. -- @param Library_Path Provider shared-library path passed to the native loader. -- @param Configuration Provider-defined text passed synchronously as a string view; no bridge interpretation. -- @return Open unique administrative owner retaining the provider and library. function Is_Open (Object : Admin_MEL) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.Open
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.Open
text: function Open (Library_Path : String; Configuration : String) return Admin_MEL; -- Unique limited controlled owner of an AdminMEL and its provider-library -- reference. A default-initialized owner is closed. Explicit Close reports -- failures; finalization attempts closure without propagating exceptions. -- Native shutdown failure permanently retains the provider/library graph -- rather than destroying objects or unloading code at an uncertain boundary. function Open (Library_Path : String; Configuration : String) return Admin_MEL;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Antenna_Height_M
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Antenna_Height_M
text: function Antenna_Height_M (Value : Physical_Data) return Long_Float; -- Query and copy one face's physical data, including complete location text. -- @param Data Open RF DataMEL; serialize the query against other owner operations. -- @param Face_ID Provider-assigned face identifier, not a one-based list index. -- @return Independent Ada-owned geometry and installation-location snapshot. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed owner, missing MFA information, invalid -- UTF-8 text or native/provider query/copy failure. function Antenna_Height_M (Value : Physical_Data) return Long_Float;

label: AMS.MEL.RF.Boresight_Pitch_Radians

Upstream specifies yaw/pitch/roll -- sequence; orientation and boresight remain separate values. function Boresight_Pitch_Radians (Value : Physical_Data) return Long_Float;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Boresight_Roll_Radians
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Boresight_Roll_Radians

Upstream specifies yaw/pitch/roll -- sequence; orientation and boresight remain separate values. function Boresight_Roll_Radians (Value : Physical_Data) return Long_Float;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Boresight_Yaw_Radians
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Boresight_Yaw_Radians

Upstream specifies yaw/pitch/roll -- sequence; orientation and boresight remain separate values. function Boresight_Yaw_Radians (Value : Physical_Data) return Long_Float;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Actual_Start_Femtoseconds
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Actual_Start_Femtoseconds
text: function Actual_Start_Femtoseconds (Object : Job) return Interfaces.Integer_64; -- Read the Claim-time provider actual-start report, not the current clock or -- proof of RF activity. Snapshot access does not require an open native handle. -- @param Object Job holding an Ada-owned snapshot, also readable after Close. -- @return Exact signed integral UTC seconds from the provider report. function Actual_Start_Femtoseconds (Object : Job) return Interfaces.Integer_64;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Actual_Start_Seconds
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Actual_Start_Seconds
text: function Actual_Start_Seconds (Object : Job) return Interfaces.Integer_64; -- Idempotently consume the public owner, without implicit Finalize or Cancel. -- With no pending finalize work, release JobDetail, then provider VA, then -- the sibling C2 claim; report synchronous deferred shutdown failure as a -- provider error after closure. With pending work, do not wait: its worker -- retains the graph and DSO until completion, potentially indefinitely. A -- throwing shutdown retains the uncertain C2/library graph without retry; -- detached cleanup cannot report it. Controlled finalization never raises. -- Ada-owned Claim-time snapshots remain unchanged and readable after Close. -- @param Object Job owner to consume; externally serialize with its other calls. function Actual_Start_Seconds (Object : Job) return Interfaces.Integer_64;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Add_Job_Intervals
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Add_Job_Intervals
text: procedure Add_Job_Intervals (Object : in out Job; Intervals : RX_Job_Interval_List) renames Add_RX_Job_Intervals; -- Synchronously serialize current safe values through native contract version 16, including mixed RX/TX. Historical v1-v15 contracts retain frozen layouts/domains: v16 uses the v8 base, TX-v3 and modulation-v5 plus context, not interchangeable array strides. Full-batch structural validation and local copied-value preparation precede one unlocked provider Add, including empty batches. Ordered intervals/events and duplicates survive. Borrowed transient Ada/C backing lasts through the call; native values own copies (native buffer copies share fresh sample vectors). Invalid final configuration raises Constraint Error before provider Add; lifecycle, registration and provider failures raise Provider Error. Add requires an open Job before any Finalize/full Cancel attempt, even if that attempt failed. Enabled reporting requires usable prior registration; no delivery guarantee. Externally serialize all same-Job calls/Close. No automatic retry: provider may mutate before throwing, and normal void return proves neither scheduling nor event execution/RF emission. Snapshot remains unchanged. -- @param Object Open Job with Add admission still available. -- @param Intervals Complete owned ordered batch; not consumed by submission. procedure Add_Job_Intervals (Object : in out Job; Intervals : RX_Job_Interval_List) renames Add_RX_Job_Intervals;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Add_RX_Job_Intervals
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Add_RX_Job_Intervals
text: procedure Add_RX_Job_Intervals (Object : in out Job; Intervals : RX_Job_Interval_List); -- Read only the local list length; no Job/provider query. -- @param Intervals Owned list to inspect. -- @return Number of stored interval values; Natural conversion is checked. -- Synchronous, externally serialized with same-Job calls and Close. -- Add/Flush reject after Finalize or full Cancel has been attempted. -- Cancel_Remaining is repeatable, including during/after Finalize, until -- full Cancel has been attempted. Failures raise Provider_Error; no retry. procedure Add_RX_Job_Intervals (Object : in out Job; Intervals : RX_Job_Interval_List);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Applicable_RX_Element_Group
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Applicable_RX_Element_Group
text: procedure Append_Applicable_RX_Element_Group (Event : in out RX_Receive_Event_Config; Element_Group_Index : Interfaces.Unsigned_64); -- Replace the RX stabilization-point index. Zero-based provider vector index, not an Ada Positive position; always present. Add checks size t representability, not the interval point count or pointing capability. -- @param Event Owned RX configuration to modify. -- @param Index Unsigned 64-bit provider index; default is zero. procedure Append_Applicable_RX_Element_Group (Event : in out RX_Receive_Event_Config; Element_Group_Index : Interfaces.Unsigned_64);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Applicable_TX_Element_Group
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Applicable_TX_Element_Group
text: procedure Append_Applicable_TX_Element_Group (Event : in out TX_Transmit_Event_Config; Element_Group_Index : Interfaces.Unsigned_64); -- Replace the TX stabilization-point index. Zero-based provider vector index, always present. Add checks size t representability but not point membership or physical steering. -- @param Event Owned TX configuration to modify. -- @param Index Unsigned 64-bit provider index; default is zero. procedure Append_Applicable_TX_Element_Group (Event : in out TX_Transmit_Event_Config; Element_Group_Index : Interfaces.Unsigned_64);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Capability_ID
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Capability_ID
text: procedure Append_Capability_ID (Config : in out Virtual_Aperture_Config; Value : AMS.MEL.IR.UCI_ID); -- Append a copied string in caller order, including empty strings. Embedded -- NUL raises a constraint error; UTF-8 is checked at native submission. -- @param Config Configuration whose local-function list is extended. -- @param Value Provider-defined local-function information. procedure Append_Capability_ID (Config : in out Virtual_Aperture_Config; Value : AMS.MEL.IR.UCI_ID);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_CPFSK_Chip
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_CPFSK_Chip
text: procedure Append_CPFSK_Chip (Config : in out Modulation_Config; Chip : Boolean); -- Copy the entire replacement in caller index order before assigning; empty clears the active vector without changing the kind or other fields. Wrong kind raises Constraint Error before mutation. Allocation failure while preparing the temporary leaves the original vector unchanged. -- @param Config Owned OnOffKeying configuration required. -- @param Pulse_Enabled Replacement owned values, copied independently, including a null array. procedure Append_CPFSK_Chip (Config : in out Modulation_Config; Chip : Boolean);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Endpoint_Connection
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Endpoint_Connection
text: procedure Append_Endpoint_Connection (Connections : in out Endpoint_Connections; Element_Group_Label, Data_Pipe_Label : String; Endpoint_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_64); -- Construct an empty owned association value; setting it on an interval expresses present-empty, distinct from Clear. -- @return Empty copied-configuration collection. procedure Append_Endpoint_Connection (Connections : in out Endpoint_Connections; Element_Group_Label, Data_Pipe_Label : String; Endpoint_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_64);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Endpoint_ID
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Endpoint_ID (overload 1/2)
text: procedure Append_Endpoint_ID (Group : in out RX_Element_Group_Config; ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_64); -- Append a copied RX frequency range in caller order. Nonfinite or reversed -- bounds raise a constraint error; no Squall-specific frequency rule applies. -- @param Group RX requirements to extend. -- @param Min_Hz Finite lower center-frequency bound in hertz. -- @param Max_Hz Finite upper center-frequency bound in hertz, at least the lower bound. procedure Append_Endpoint_ID (Group : in out RX_Element_Group_Config; ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_64);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Endpoint_ID
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Endpoint_ID (overload 2/2)
text: procedure Append_Endpoint_ID (Group : in out RX_Element_Group_Config; Data_Pipe_Label : String; ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_64); -- Append a copied endpoint identity to the configured default pipe. -- Pipe collections retain insertion order. Duplicate IDs within one -- collection raise a constraint error; empty collections are omitted. -- @param Group RX requirements; use the default pipe label saved at construction. -- @param ID Exact unsigned 64-bit endpoint ID to associate at submission. procedure Append_Endpoint_ID (Group : in out RX_Element_Group_Config; Data_Pipe_Label : String; ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_64);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Expected_Center_Frequency
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Expected_Center_Frequency (overload 1/2)
text: procedure Append_Expected_Center_Frequency (Group : in out TX_Element_Group_Config; Min_Hz, Max_Hz : Long_Float); -- Copy TX requirements without calling the provider. Embedded NUL or a -- nonfinite duty outside (0, 1] raises a constraint error. Submission checks -- label UTF-8 and the provider-created command's TX mode independently. -- @param Label Provider element-group label; empty text is allowed. -- @param TX_Power_Level Exact unsigned provider TxPowerLevel, not a power-mode ID. -- @param Desired_Duty_Factor Finite requested fraction, strictly positive and at most one. -- @return Owned TX requirements with an empty frequency list. procedure Append_Expected_Center_Frequency (Group : in out TX_Element_Group_Config; Min_Hz, Max_Hz : Long_Float);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Expected_Center_Frequency
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Expected_Center_Frequency (overload 2/2)
text: procedure Append_Expected_Center_Frequency (Group : in out RX_Element_Group_Config; Min_Hz, Max_Hz : Long_Float); -- Copy RX requirements, initially without frequencies, endpoints or expected -- pointings. Embedded NUL in either label, or nonfinite duty outside (0, 1], -- raises a constraint error. UTF-8 and command RX mode are checked at native -- submission. Constructing this value neither associates an actual endpoint -- nor starts receive activity. -- @param Label Provider element-group label; empty text is allowed. -- @param Desired_Duty_Factor Finite requested fraction, strictly positive and at most one. -- @param Data_Pipe_Label Default pipe label used by the two-argument endpoint append. -- @return Independently owned RX configuration value. procedure Append_Expected_Center_Frequency (Group : in out RX_Element_Group_Config; Min_Hz, Max_Hz : Long_Float);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Expected_Pointing
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_Expected_Pointing
text: procedure Append_Expected_Pointing (Group : in out RX_Element_Group_Config; Value : Pointing); -- Read absolute-pointing validity time; relative kinds raise a constraint error. -- @param Value ECEF or LLA pointing. -- @return Copied canonical UTC pair. procedure Append_Expected_Pointing (Group : in out RX_Element_Group_Config; Value : Pointing);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_RX_Event
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Append_RX_Event
text: procedure Append_RX_Event (Interval : in out RX_Job_Interval_Config; Event : RX_Receive_Event_Config); -- Copy interval scalars with empty RX events, points, commands and activity; optional collections absent, Normal execution, power mode zero and status Never. All signed timings, including negative values, pass without quantization or relationship checks. Counts must fit provider size t at Add; no infinite-repeat meaning is assigned to zero. Native doubles retain signed zero and nonfinite classification without range validation, not NaN payload bits. -- @param Interval_ID Exact unsigned 32-bit interval identity; no uniqueness validation. -- @param Sequence_Duration_Femtoseconds Signed 64-bit sequence duration in femtoseconds. -- @param Job_Details_ID Unsigned 32-bit JobDetail identity, default zero; no equality check with the receiving Job. -- @param Interval_Start_Femtoseconds Signed femtoseconds relative to Job start; default pinned continuation zero, ambiguous with ordinary zero start. -- @param Interval_Starting_Gap_Femtoseconds Signed femtoseconds before the initial sequence, default zero. -- @param Sequence_Repeat_Count Unsigned 64-bit sequence repetitions, default one; size t representability checked at Add. -- @param Calibration_Duration_Femtoseconds Signed femtoseconds for calibration following sequence iterations, default zero. -- @param Interval_Ending_Gap_Femtoseconds Signed femtoseconds following calibration, default zero. -- @param Phase_Coherence_With_Prior Requested coherence with preceding interval, default False; not a bridge phase guarantee. -- @param Iterations_Per_Signal Unsigned repetition interval for product-availability signaling, default zero; upstream zero suppresses periodic signaling but describes a final-Job signal. No bridge delivery guarantee. -- @param Max_Data_Rate_BPS Per-channel maximum bits per second, native double, default zero. -- @param Max_Sample_Rate_Hz Per-channel maximum sample rate in Hz, native double, default zero. -- @return Owned interval configuration, not a scheduled or executing interval. procedure Append_RX_Event (Interval : in out RX_Job_Interval_Config; Event : RX_Receive_Event_Config);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.C2_MEL
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.C2_MEL
text: type C2_MEL is tagged limited private; -- Consumer-side RF command ownership, asynchronous resource requests and -- copied configuration/snapshots over the published RF MEL interfaces. -- Provider reports and successful bridge calls do not establish physical -- aperture activation, scheduling or RF transmission. Externally serialize -- operations and closure on each owner; timeout is never cancellation. type C2_MEL is tagged limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Cancel_Error
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Cancel_Error
text: type Cancel_Error is (None); type Cancel_Error is (None);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Cancel_Job
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Cancel_Job
text: function Cancel_Job (Object : in out Job) return Cancel_Result; -- Await the Finalize future's cached completion, not a physical RF state. -- Waiting before a Finalize attempt raises a provider error. Timeout raises -- a timeout error without cancellation or ownership consumption. Synchronous -- Finalize failures, future exceptions, unknown statuses and native failures -- raise a provider error; the six known statuses, including failed statuses, -- return as data. Repeated completion waits return the cached status or error, -- even for an unset or in-progress value; no further provider polling occurs. -- @param Object Open Job retaining the future/provider graph despite parent closure. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum completion wait in milliseconds; zero polls. -- @return Known status supplied by the single consumed Finalize future. function Cancel_Job (Object : in out Job) return Cancel_Result;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Cancel_Remaining_Job_Intervals
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Cancel_Remaining_Job_Intervals
text: procedure Cancel_Remaining_Job_Intervals (Object : in out Job); -- Synchronously call provider flush once per admitted invocation, requesting buffered intervals be sent. Allowed only before any Finalize/full Cancel attempt, even a failed attempt. Does not Finalize or alter copied snapshots. Provider failures raise Provider Error with no retry; mutation may precede a throw. Normal void return does not prove delivery, scheduling or RF execution. No status registration required. -- @param Object Open Job; externally serialize same-Job calls and Close. procedure Cancel_Remaining_Job_Intervals (Object : in out Job);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Cancel_Result
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Cancel_Result
text: type Cancel_Result is private; type Cancel_Result is private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Cancelled
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Cancelled
text: function Cancelled (Result : Cancel_Result) return Boolean; -- Copied cached cancellation Boolean and error. False with None is a valid -- provider rejection; native/provider exceptions are raised, not fabricated -- as another Boolean result. Contains no Job or provider owner. function Cancelled (Result : Cancel_Result) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Close
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Close (overload 5/5)
text: procedure Close (Object : in out Job); -- Synchronously call cancelJob once and cache its Boolean/error separately. -- Repeats return the same result or raise the cached provider error without -- retry. Unknown error codes and provider/native exceptions raise a provider -- error, not False. A normal False/None result is permitted. The provider may -- complete the Finalize future during cancellation; this call is not that -- future wait and does not destroy the Job. A first Cancel attempt prohibits -- starting Finalize afterward regardless of cancellation success. No physical -- RF cessation or universal provider timing guarantee is inferred. -- @param Object Open Job; externally serialize all same-Job operations and Close. -- @return Copied provider-reported cancellation success and validated error code. procedure Close (Object : in out Job);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.Associate_Endpoint
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.Associate_Endpoint
text: function Associate_Endpoint (Object : in out Virtual_Aperture'Class; Element_Group_Label, Data_Pipe_Label : String; Endpoint_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_64) return Boolean; -- Read the provider std::set endpoint order, not insertion order. -- @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained -- native owner. -- @param Index Positive one-based position; beyond the stored count raises Constraint -- Error. -- @return Unsigned 64-bit endpoint ID preserving all bits. -- Each command obtains its own fresh VA::getDataPipes value and invokes -- the exact mutation once. True/False is successful provider return data, -- not proof of routing, connectivity, RDMA/Q-pairs, hardware or persistence. -- No cache/capability gate/retry/readback. Missing keys raise Provider_Error. -- Embedded NUL raises Constraint_Error before native entry; C validates UTF-8. function Associate_Endpoint (Object : in out Virtual_Aperture'Class; Element_Group_Label, Data_Pipe_Label : String; Endpoint_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_64) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.Associate_Endpoints
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.Associate_Endpoints
text: function Associate_Endpoints (Object : in out Virtual_Aperture'Class; Element_Group_Label, Data_Pipe_Label : String; Endpoint_IDs : Endpoint_ID_Array) return Boolean; -- Obtain a fresh VA getDataPipes map, resolve existing exact keys, then invoke -- associateEndpoint exactly once. Missing keys are errors, never automatic insertions. No -- capability gate, retry, cache or state readback. Native/provider failures raise Provider -- Error. Provider acceptance does not establish actual connectivity, RDMA/Q-pairs, -- writable memory registration, hardware routing, persistent configuration or physical -- data delivery. -- @param Object Live VA; externally serialize all same-VA operations, including Close. The -- existing VA claim survives public C2 closure. -- @param Element_Group_Label Exact outer lookup key; embedded NUL raises Constraint Error -- before native entry. Native code validates UTF-8. -- @param Data_Pipe_Label Exact inner lookup key, not returned display label. Embedded NUL -- raises Constraint Error; native code validates UTF-8. -- @param Endpoint_ID Exact unsigned 64-bit endpoint ID, without narrowing or local -- membership checks. -- @return True or False is successful provider return data, not transport status or a -- connectivity guarantee. -- Upstream std::set semantics: ordering insignificant, duplicates collapse. -- An empty array is valid and forwarded as an empty set exactly once. function Associate_Endpoints (Object : in out Virtual_Aperture'Class; Element_Group_Label, Data_Pipe_Label : String; Endpoint_IDs : Endpoint_ID_Array) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.Connection_Snapshot
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.Connection_Snapshot
text: type Connection_Snapshot is private; -- Conditional VA-level connection snapshots and endpoint associations, separate from -- descriptor-level optional pipes. Values own their data and retain no provider lifetime. -- Each mutation obtains a fresh VA connection map and invokes the exact provider operation -- once, with no automatic capability gate, retry or readback. Externally serialize same-VA -- operations and Close; the existing VA owner remains valid after public C2 Close. type Connection_Snapshot is private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Extend_Job_Event
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Extend_Job_Event
text: procedure Extend_Job_Event (Object : in out Job; Interval_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Event_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Added_Duration_Femtoseconds : Interfaces.Integer_64); -- Synchronously request removal of unexecuted intervals; distinct from full Cancel Job and does not consume that full-Cancel attempt. Repeatable before/during/after Finalize until any full Cancel attempt, including False or exception. No status registration required. Each admitted call invokes provider once, with no automatic retry; mutation may precede Provider Error. Normal void return proves neither effective cancellation nor notification; immutable snapshot is unchanged. -- @param Object Open Job; externally serialize same-Job calls and Close. -- Repeatable, including before/during/after Finalize, until full Cancel -- has been attempted (even False or an exception). No status stream is -- required. Normal return means only the provider's void method returned -- without throwing, not acceptance, effective extension or notification. -- Exact signed femtoseconds; no validation, arithmetic or quantization. -- Never automatically retries. Explicit retries after failure require -- provider-specific knowledge because mutation may precede an exception. -- Same-Job calls/Close are externally serialized; snapshot is unchanged. procedure Extend_Job_Event (Object : in out Job; Interval_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Event_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Added_Duration_Femtoseconds : Interfaces.Integer_64);

label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Interval_Status.Interval_ID
text: function Interval_ID (Event : Status_Event) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32; -- Consume the next FIFO observation and copy it into Ada storage. -- Stop takes priority over queued data. Timeout Error means no observation -- arrived within the wait, not cancellation; Stream Stopped means stopped. -- Native failures or invalid native views raise Provider Error. Unknown -- callback enums are dropped natively, not returned as partial events. -- @param Object Open local observer; may already be logically stopped. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls. -- @return Independent copied observation, including normal failure statuses. function Interval_ID (Event : Status_Event) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Interval_Status.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Interval_Status.Is_Open
text: function Is_Open (Object : Stream) return Boolean; -- Attempt registration once on the Job, before Finalize or full Cancel. -- A synchronous callback during registration is supported. An exposed -- registration attempt is consumed even if the provider throws. -- The fixed FIFO drops incoming observations when full; malformed enums, -- oversize payloads and allocation failures discard whole observations. -- Limits bound queued storage, not provider argument construction, -- concurrent callback temporaries or application-held Status Event copies. -- Native option/lifecycle/registration failures raise Provider Error. -- @param Object Live Job whose status is observed, not retained by Stream. -- @param Queue_Capacity Maximum number of queued observations; positive. -- @param Max_Event_Log_Entries Maximum entries per observation; zero allows -- only an empty log. -- @param Max_Activity_ID_Bytes Maximum activity bytes per observation; zero -- allows only an empty activity ID. -- @return Open observer; no delivery or physical RF activity is promised. function Is_Open (Object : Stream) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Is_Open

text: function Is_Open (Object : C2_MEL) return Boolean; -- Load the library and call only createC2MEL. Embedded NUL in either input -- raises a constraint error before temporary C-string allocation. Temporary -- strings are freed on exceptional exits too. Loading, symbol lookup, native -- allocation, null factory result and factory exceptions raise a provider -- error without returning an open owner. Configuration is not interpreted -- by the bridge; this entry point does not validate it as UTF-8. -- @param Library_Path Provider shared-library path for the native loader. -- @param Configuration Provider-defined factory text, passed synchronously. -- @return Independent owner retaining the provider object and library. function Is_Open (Object : C2_MEL) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Is_Open (overload 2/5)
text: function Is_Open (Request : Virtual_Aperture_Request) return Boolean; -- Validate and copy all request inputs before invoking requestVirtualAperture. -- Native text spans require UTF-8 without NUL. Invalid inputs, a closed parent, -- synchronous provider failure or invalid future raise a provider error and -- publish no request. Post-submission worker/publication failure retains the -- future and provider graph rather than assuming cancellation. Normal return -- means submission only, not successful allocation or physical activation. -- @param Parent Open independent C2 owner; serialize with parent closure. -- @param Config Copied request values; no caller storage is borrowed afterward. -- @return Open request for subsequent bounded Wait and unique Claim. function Is_Open (Request : Virtual_Aperture_Request) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Is_Open (overload 3/5)
text: function Is_Open (Object : Virtual_Aperture) return Boolean; -- Transfer a successful request's resource exactly once. Pending, failed or -- previously claimed requests raise a provider error. Native getters build -- the complete snapshot before publication; a getter-started failure is cached -- without retrying those getters. Ada copies the snapshot and cleans the new -- owner if copying raises. Claim does not establish physical activation. -- @param Request Open successfully completed request; serialize its operations. -- @return Independent aperture owner with sorted IDs, copied labels and group flag. function Is_Open (Object : Virtual_Aperture) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Is_Open (overload 4/5)
text: function Is_Open (Request : Job_Request) return Boolean; -- Copy and validate requirements before provider entry, then create each -- command by label, require its selected RX/TX mode, populate requirements -- and call requestJob once. At least one total group is required; RX-only, -- TX-only and mixed requests are bridge inputs, not provider support claims. -- Labels must be UTF-8 without NUL. Validation/preparation failure publishes -- no request. A mode mismatch or synchronous native/provider failure raises -- a provider error; provider command mutations may precede a later exception, -- so this is not a provider rollback guarantee. Post-send worker/publication -- failure retains the future and graph. No physical RF activity is promised. -- @param VA Open aperture with C2 child admission still open; serialize submission with other owner calls and Close. -- @param Config Owned values copied synchronously, with no retained caller spans. -- @return Open asynchronous request, not a scheduling acceptance result. function Is_Open (Request : Job_Request) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Is_Open (overload 5/5)
text: function Is_Open (Object : Job) return Boolean; -- Transfer successful Job ownership exactly once. Pending, failed or already -- claimed requests raise a provider error. Native getters build a complete -- immutable snapshot before publication; getter-started failure is cached, -- so no provider getter is retried. Ada copies all fields and cleans its new -- owner if copying raises. The snapshot includes only getRxStreamIDs(0), not -- all groups. Request and public VA/C2 may close without invalidating the Job. -- @param Request Open successfully completed request; serialize its operations. -- @return Independent Job owner and copied snapshot, not an RF execution guarantee. function Is_Open (Object : Job) return Boolean;

Timeout raises a timeout error without cancelling -- or consuming work. Provider rejection and null successful pointers return -- failure data; future exceptions and native failures raise a provider error. -- @param Request Open request; externally serialize its operations and Close. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls. -- @return Copied terminal category, mapped code and complete diagnostic. type Job is limited private;
