name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Job_Status
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Job_Status
text: type Job_Status is (None, In_Progress, Complete, Failed_Invalid_ID, Failed_Interrupted, Failed_Invalid_State); -- Synchronously forward exact IDs and signed femtoseconds once per admitted call. Repeatable before/during/after Finalize until any full Cancel attempt, including False or exception. No lookup, cumulative budget accounting, duration arithmetic, quantization or automatic retry. Provider may mutate before Provider Error; explicit retries require provider-specific knowledge. Normal void return proves neither support, effective extension nor notification. Status registration is optional and snapshot unchanged; external same-Job/Close serialization required. -- @param Object Open Job not blocked by a full Cancel attempt. -- @param Interval_ID Full unsigned 32-bit interval identity, no bridge existence check. -- @param Event_ID Full unsigned 32-bit event identity, no bridge membership check. -- @param Added_Duration_Femtoseconds Exact signed 64-bit added duration; zero, negative and extrema pass unchanged, not an interval-start sentinel. type Job_Status is (None, In_Progress, Complete, Failed_Invalid_ID, Failed_Interrupted, Failed_Invalid_State);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Modulation_Config
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Modulation_Config
text: type Modulation_Config is private; -- Copyable Ada-owned TX event values, independent of subsequent edits to copies. -- Defaults are zero scalar fields, empty label/groups/polarization, Normal -- execution, Inhibit Event termination and False correction/delay/channelization. -- Stabilization index is always present and initially zero, not optional. -- Hold and termination counts default to zero. Add validates the whole batch -- before provider Add: UTF-8 labels without NUL, collection structure, enum -- domains and size t representability, not group membership or physical ranges. -- Floating values become native double without normalization or finite checks; -- IEEE signed zero, infinity and NaN classification survive, not NaN payload bits. -- Configuration is not execution, beam steering or cancellation. Provider -- capabilities and interpretation remain provider-defined. -- TX adds attenuation in dB and rise/fall durations, all initially zero. -- Modulation references are absent by default, retaining upstream {-1}. -- TX attenuation is neither TX Power Level nor an interval TX Power Mode ID; -- no RX sample frequency, AGC or pulse-detection configuration is exposed. type Modulation_Config is private;

Interfaces.Integer_32'Last;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Open

text: function Open (Library_Path : String; Configuration : String) return C2_MEL; -- Unique limited controlled owner of the independent RF command interface -- and its shared-library reference, not an Admin or DataMEL owner. Default -- initialization is closed. Externally serialize use, Close and finalization -- on each public owner. Explicit Close reports errors; controlled cleanup -- does not raise. Native child claims defer shutdown beyond parent closure. function Open (Library_Path : String; Configuration : String) return C2_MEL;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Product_Stream_Params
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Product_Stream_Params
text: type Product_Stream_Params is private; -- Copyable Ada-owned interval configuration, now supporting both ordered RX and TX -- events despite the historical RX name. No resource allocation or scheduling. -- Default collections are empty, status Never, execution Normal, power mode zero; -- TX events, modulations, endpoint connections, product parameters and user context -- each have independent absent/present-empty/present-nonempty configuration states. -- Absence skips the corresponding native setter; native defaults can equal an -- explicit empty value, so provider-observable distinction is not guaranteed. -- Set/append operations own copies; no manual Close or provider pointer escapes. -- Upstream sequence nonoverlap, switching time, event-end/sequence duration, -- quantization and hardware constraints remain application/provider obligations; -- the bridge does not implement a scheduler or infer these relationships. -- Owned value configuration only. Numeric addresses are not access values; -- application/provider remain responsible for endpoint matching, registered -- writable storage and its execution lifetime. No memory-safety guarantee. type Product_Stream_Params is private;

text: type Pulse_Threshold_Reference is (DBQ, DB_Above_Noise, DB_Below_Saturation); -- Pinned RF MEL 762ce84 continuation count is zero, not INT64 MAX: -- numeric limits<Femtoseconds>::max() is unspecialized, unlike Femtoseconds::max(). -- Zero also encodes an ordinary relative start; the scalar interface cannot -- distinguish intentions or guarantee continuation scheduling. No remapping. type Pulse_Threshold_Reference is (DBQ, DB_Above_Noise, DB_Below_Saturation);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Replace_Waveform_Stream
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Replace_Waveform_Stream
text: procedure Replace_Waveform_Stream (Config : in out Modulation_Config; Endpoint_ID, Start_Address, Num_Bytes : Interfaces.Unsigned_64; Sample_Format : Stream_Sample_Format; Item_Format : Stream_Item_Format; Repeat_Mode : Stream_Repeat_Mode); -- Select kind 7, the outer native WaveformStream alternative, and copy six scalar descriptors. No endpoint acquisition, allocation, registration, mapping, dereference or transfer of backing memory occurs. Application/provider own memory extent, lifetime and capability obligations; zero values are structurally valid, not proof of an executable stream. -- @param Endpoint_ID Full unsigned 64-bit endpoint identity; no existence query. -- @param Start_Address Full unsigned 64-bit numeric descriptor, not an Ada access value or bridge-owned pointer. -- @param Num_Bytes Unsigned 64-bit bytes per iteration; must fit native size t at Add (checked Ada conversion/round trip). Zero is accepted. -- @param Sample_Format Sample shape, default ComplexCartesian in the constructor. -- @param Item_Format Numeric item descriptor, default FixedPointSigned in the constructor. -- @param Repeat_Mode Provider repeat policy, default RepeatFromTop in the constructor. -- @return Owned stream descriptor without any backing-storage owner. procedure Replace_Waveform_Stream (Config : in out Modulation_Config; Endpoint_ID, Start_Address, Num_Bytes : Interfaces.Unsigned_64; Sample_Format : Stream_Sample_Format; Item_Format : Stream_Item_Format; Repeat_Mode : Stream_Repeat_Mode);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Request_Outcome
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Request_Outcome
text: type Request_Outcome is (Created, Failed); -- Nonblocking, idempotent abandonment, not cancellation. Pending work keeps -- its claim. An unclaimed successful aperture is destroyed by native cleanup -- before the claim releases; an already claimed aperture remains independent. -- @param Request Owner to consume; do not race Wait, Claim or Close on it. type Request_Outcome is (Created, Failed);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.RX_Element_Group_Config
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.RX_Element_Group_Config
text: type RX_Element_Group_Config is private; -- Consume the handle idempotently, destroy its provider aperture reference, -- then release its C2 claim. Jobs retain their own provider reference and -- sibling claim. A final-child deferred shutdown exception raises a provider -- error after closure and retains the uncertain C2/library graph permanently. -- No shutdown retry occurs; finalization suppresses cleanup errors. Ada-owned -- snapshots are unchanged. This is resource release, not physical deactivation. -- @param Object Owner to close; serialize with submission and other owner calls. type RX_Element_Group_Config is private;

Constructors put one group first; -- appends preserve global RX/TX order and duplicate labels. Initial times, -- duration and lookahead are zero; capability/activity/power-mode IDs are -- each [0], instances empty and estimated pointing absent. Submission leaves -- upstream JIB controls, callbacks and context at pinned defaults. name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Stream_Sample_Format
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Stream_Sample_Format
text: type Stream_Sample_Format is (Stream_Real, Stream_Complex_Cartesian, Stream_Complex_Polar); -- Ada-owned copyable tagged configuration, defaulting to Tone. Bridge kinds -- 0/1/2/3/4/5/6/7 select Tone, PhaseCode, LinearFrequencyModulation, -- OnOffKeying, CpfskPulse, CustomWaveform, WaveformBuffer and WaveformStream. -- These tags are not C++ variant positions: the first seven select an inner -- CommonModulations alternative inside Modulation; Stream selects the outer -- WaveformStream alternative directly. Cached/extension alternatives are not exposed. -- Only the active payload is serialized/validated. Scalars and arrays are copied; -- native buffer copies share their fresh sample allocation, not caller storage. -- Native double conversion preserves signed zero, infinities and NaN classification, -- not NaN payload bits. No normalization, waveform synthesis, frequency-domain -- conversion or provider capability guarantee follows from construction. -- All active definitions, including unused ones, validate before provider Add. -- Presence belongs independently to interval tables and TX reference collections. type Stream_Sample_Format is (Stream_Real, Stream_Complex_Cartesian, Stream_Complex_Polar);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Submit_Job
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Submit_Job
text: function Submit_Job (VA : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Config : Job_Config) return Job_Request; -- Unique controlled asynchronous JobDetail request owner. Native work retains -- a strong provider VA and a sibling C2 child claim independently of public -- VA/C2 owners. One worker consumes the RequestFor future and caches terminal -- data. Default initialization is closed; non-raising finalization abandons, -- never cancels. Unresolved work may retain the provider/library indefinitely. function Submit_Job (VA : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Config : Job_Config) return Job_Request;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Submit_Virtual_Aperture

text: function Submit_Virtual_Aperture (Parent : C2_MEL'Class; Config : Virtual_Aperture_Config) return Virtual_Aperture_Request; -- Unique controlled asynchronous request owner. A native worker consumes the -- RequestFor future once and caches its outcome. One C2 child claim follows -- pending work, unclaimed success and the claimed aperture. Public parent -- closure does not invalidate that graph; a never-ready future can retain it -- indefinitely. Default initialization is closed; finalization abandons -- without raising, not by cancelling the provider request. function Submit_Virtual_Aperture (Parent : C2_MEL'Class; Config : Virtual_Aperture_Config) return Virtual_Aperture_Request;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Transmit_Power.Aperture_Gain_DB
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Transmit_Power.Aperture_Gain_DB
text: function Aperture_Gain_DB (Object : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Element_Group : Element_Group_ID; Power_Mode_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Weight_Type : Weight_Type_ID; Center_Frequency_Hz : Long_Float; Line_Of_Sight : UV_Line_Of_Sight; VA_Instance_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0) return Long_Float; -- Invoke conditional RequiredIfTransmit getTxPeakRadiatedPower exactly once. No automatic -- capability gate, RF formula, caching, interpolation or reconciliation with separately -- queried values. Inputs/results preserve floating-point semantic values, including signed -- zero, infinity and NaN classification, without finite/range enforcement; no NaN payload- -- bit guarantee. Native/provider failures raise Provider Error. A returned number does not -- prove transmission, emission, antenna performance or valid hardware state. -- @param Object Live claimed VA; externally serialize with all same-VA calls, including -- Close. Its existing native claim remains usable after public C2 Close. -- @param Element_Group Provider numeric transmit-group ID; must fit native size t. -- @param Power_Mode_ID Provider power-mode ID, distinct from attenuation and weight type. -- @param VA_Instance_ID Provider-defined VA instance selection, default 0; no local -- membership check. -- @param Attenuation_DB Provider attenuation input in dB, forwarded without clipping. -- @param Center_Frequency_Hz Center frequency in Hz, without unit conversion or -- interpolation. -- @return Provider peak radiated output power in dBW; no inferred relationship to other -- query results. function Aperture_Gain_DB (Object : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Element_Group : Element_Group_ID; Power_Mode_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Weight_Type : Weight_Type_ID; Center_Frequency_Hz : Long_Float; Line_Of_Sight : UV_Line_Of_Sight; VA_Instance_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0) return Long_Float;

No local calculation or automatic capability gate is -- supplied. A successful numeric result is provider data, not proof of physical RF -- activity. Calls require an existing live VA and same-VA external serialization, -- including Close; the public C2 may already be closed. subtype Element_Group_ID is Interfaces.Unsigned_64;

text: function Max_Attenuation_DB (Object : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Element_Group : Element_Group_ID; Power_Mode_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; VA_Instance_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0) return Long_Float; -- Invoke conditional RequiredIfTransmit getTxApertureGain exactly once. No automatic -- capability gate, RF formula, caching, interpolation or reconciliation with separately -- queried values. Inputs/results preserve floating-point semantic values, including signed -- zero, infinity and NaN classification, without finite/range enforcement; no NaN payload- -- bit guarantee. Native/provider failures raise Provider Error. A returned number does not -- prove transmission, emission, antenna performance or valid hardware state. -- @param Object Live claimed VA; externally serialize with all same-VA calls, including -- Close. Its existing native claim remains usable after public C2 Close. -- @param Element_Group Provider numeric transmit-group ID; must fit native size t. -- @param Power_Mode_ID Provider power-mode ID, distinct from attenuation and weight type. -- @param VA_Instance_ID Provider-defined VA instance selection, default 0; no local -- membership check. -- @param Weight_Type Provider weight-type ID fitting native size t; no Weights owner is -- allocated. -- @param Center_Frequency_Hz Center frequency in Hz, without unit conversion or -- interpolation. -- @param Line_Of_Sight U/V components passed verbatim as an AnglePair, not normalized. -- @return Provider transmit aperture gain in dB; no inferred relationship to other query -- results. function Max_Attenuation_DB (Object : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Element_Group : Element_Group_ID; Power_Mode_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; VA_Instance_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0) return Long_Float;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Transmit_Power.Peak_Radiated_Power_DBW
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Transmit_Power.Peak_Radiated_Power_DBW
text: function Peak_Radiated_Power_DBW (Object : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Element_Group : Element_Group_ID; Power_Mode_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Attenuation_DB : Long_Float; Center_Frequency_Hz : Long_Float; VA_Instance_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0) return Long_Float; -- Invoke conditional RequiredIfTransmit getTxRadiatedPower exactly once. No automatic -- capability gate, RF formula, caching, interpolation or reconciliation with separately -- queried values. Inputs/results preserve floating-point semantic values, including signed -- zero, infinity and NaN classification, without finite/range enforcement; no NaN payload- -- bit guarantee. Native/provider failures raise Provider Error. A returned number does not -- prove transmission, emission, antenna performance or valid hardware state. -- @param Object Live claimed VA; externally serialize with all same-VA calls, including -- Close. Its existing native claim remains usable after public C2 Close. -- @param Element_Group Provider numeric transmit-group ID; must fit native size t. -- @param Power_Mode_ID Provider power-mode ID, distinct from attenuation and weight type. -- @param VA_Instance_ID Provider-defined VA instance selection, default 0; no local -- membership check. -- @param Attenuation_DB Provider attenuation input in dB, forwarded without clipping. -- @param Weight_Type Provider weight-type ID fitting native size t; no Weights owner is -- allocated. -- @param Center_Frequency_Hz Center frequency in Hz, without unit conversion or -- interpolation. -- @param Line_Of_Sight U/V components passed verbatim as an AnglePair, not normalized. -- @return Provider radiated output power in dBW; no inferred relationship to other query -- results. function Peak_Radiated_Power_DBW (Object : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Element_Group : Element_Group_ID; Power_Mode_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Attenuation_DB : Long_Float; Center_Frequency_Hz : Long_Float; VA_Instance_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0) return Long_Float;

label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Transmit_Power.Radiated_Power_DBW
text: function Radiated_Power_DBW (Object : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Element_Group : Element_Group_ID; Power_Mode_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Attenuation_DB : Long_Float; Weight_Type : Weight_Type_ID; Center_Frequency_Hz : Long_Float; Line_Of_Sight : UV_Line_Of_Sight; VA_Instance_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0) return Long_Float; -- Upstream AnglePair line-of-sight/stabilization components, forwarded without -- normalization, conversion or local physical range checks. -- @field U First upstream U component, passed unchanged. -- @field V Second upstream V component, passed unchanged. function Radiated_Power_DBW (Object : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Element_Group : Element_Group_ID; Power_Mode_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32; Attenuation_DB : Long_Float; Weight_Type : Weight_Type_ID; Center_Frequency_Hz : Long_Float; Line_Of_Sight : UV_Line_Of_Sight; VA_Instance_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32 := 0) return Long_Float;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.TX_Element_Group_Config
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.TX_Element_Group_Config
text: type TX_Element_Group_Config is private; -- TX JobRequest requirements only; this does not execute a TX interval. -- Power is exact provider-defined TxPowerLevel, not a TxPowerModeID. type TX_Element_Group_Config is private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.TX_Transmit_Event_Config
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.TX_Transmit_Event_Config
text: type TX_Transmit_Event_Config is private; -- Copyable Ada-owned RX event values, independent of subsequent edits to copies. -- Defaults are zero scalar fields, empty label/groups/polarization, Normal -- execution, Inhibit Event termination and False correction/delay/channelization. -- Stabilization index is always present and initially zero, not optional. -- Hold and termination counts default to zero. Add validates the whole batch -- before provider Add: UTF-8 labels without NUL, collection structure, enum -- domains and size t representability, not group membership or physical ranges. -- Floating values become native double without normalization or finite checks; -- IEEE signed zero, infinity and NaN classification survive, not NaN payload bits. -- Configuration is not execution, beam steering or cancellation. Provider -- capabilities and interpretation remain provider-defined. -- RX adds sample frequency, AGC counts and maximum extension; pulse settings -- are absent until Set, leaving upstream default settings when omitted. type TX_Transmit_Event_Config is private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.UTC_Time
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.UTC_Time

Embedded NUL in -- the label or a duplicate ID within that pipe raises a constraint error. -- Existing pipe collections retain insertion order; IDs become a set during -- submission. The same ID in distinct pipes is not rejected locally. No live -- VA pipe lookup or endpoint allocation is performed here. -- @param Group RX requirements to extend. -- @param Data_Pipe_Label Pipe association label; native submission validates UTF-8. -- @param ID Exact unsigned 64-bit endpoint identity, including zero/high bits. type UTC_Time is private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture
text: type Virtual_Aperture is tagged limited private; -- Wait for cached completion, not aperture activation. Repeated terminal -- waits return the same data without consuming the future again. Timeout -- raises a timeout error and leaves work pending; provider rejection returns -- failure data, whereas future exceptions and native failures raise a provider -- error. A null successful provider pointer is failure data, not Created. -- @param Request Open request; serialize with its Close and Claim. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum completion wait in milliseconds; zero polls. -- @return Copied terminal outcome, mapped code and complete diagnostic. type Virtual_Aperture is tagged limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Config
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Config
text: type Virtual_Aperture_Config is private; -- A bounded request or Job-status wait expired. Zero milliseconds polls. -- Timeout neither cancels work nor consumes a request, result or owner. type Virtual_Aperture_Config is private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Close
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Close
text: procedure Close (Object : in out Subscription); -- Stop reception before attempting exact provider-key removal once. Cache -- the removal outcome, including failure; repeated calls do not retry. -- Provider failures raise Provider Error. Removal can block and provides no -- callback-quiescence guarantee; the callable shell remains permanent. -- @param VA Matching live VA; serialize with same-VA operations and Close. -- @param Object Matching local subscription; remains locally open but stopped. -- Local stop/closure only: NO provider call. Nonraising finalization does -- only this. Automatic removal occurs at VA Close even after local Close. -- Wait/Statistics may overlap VA Close, not this wrapper's destruction. procedure Close (Object : in out Subscription);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Is_Open
text: function Is_Open (Object : Subscription) return Boolean; -- Attempt one registration per VA; it may invoke the callback synchronously. -- Normal return proves registration returned, not later notification delivery. -- Provider/native failures raise Provider Error; no arbitrary retry follows -- an exposed registration attempt, even after local closure or unsubscribe. -- @param VA Live VA; serialize registration with all same-VA operations. -- @return Local observer, not an owned provider-resource graph. -- Local wrapper ownership only, not active provider registration. function Is_Open (Object : Subscription) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Open
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Open
text: function Open (VA : in out Virtual_Aperture'Class) return Subscription; -- Limited local signal owner with non-raising controlled cleanup. The -- permanent callable/signal/DSO shell retains no VA or C2 owner. Its callback -- ignores the provider reference entirely and never dereferences it. -- One attempted registration per public VA, even after Unsubscribe/Close. -- Serialize Open/Unsubscribe with all same-VA calls, including VA Close. function Open (VA : in out Virtual_Aperture'Class) return Subscription;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Statistics
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Statistics
text: function Statistics (Object : Subscription) return Subscription_Statistics; -- Consistent nonconsuming bridge signal statistics; counters saturate at -- Unsigned 64'Last rather than wrapping. No provider state is included. -- @field Callback_Entries All callable entries, including stopped entries. -- @field Callbacks_Coalesced Active entries arriving while already pending. -- @field Notifications_Delivered Successful waits consuming a pending signal. -- @field Callbacks_After_Stop Stopped callback entries counted and discarded. -- @field Pending An unconsumed coalesced signal exists, not a delivered snapshot. -- @field Stopped Reception has stopped; pending is cleared. -- Consistent, nonconsuming snapshot. Counters saturate at Unsigned_64'Last: -- entries includes all calls, coalesced counts active/already-pending calls, -- delivered counts successful waits, after-stop counts discarded calls. function Statistics (Object : Subscription) return Subscription_Statistics;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Subscription
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Subscription
text: type Subscription is tagged limited private; -- Observe signal-only callback entry, not live provider state. Register, -- query current status on the application thread, wait, then query again. -- Notifications contain no snapshot and do not guarantee changed state. type Subscription is tagged limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Subscription_Statistics
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Subscription_Statistics
text: type Subscription_Statistics is record Callback_Entries : Interfaces.Unsigned_64; Callbacks_Coalesced : Interfaces.Unsigned_64; Notifications_Delivered : Interfaces.Unsigned_64; Callbacks_After_Stop : Interfaces.Unsigned_64; Pending, Stopped : Boolean; end record; -- Consume one pending signal. Multiple callback entries coalesce into one -- pending notification; successful waits increment delivered, not entries. -- Stop clears pending and has priority. Raises Timeout Error on absence, -- Subscription Stopped on stop, and Provider Error for other native errors. -- @param Object Open local subscription; no provider getter is called. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls. type Subscription_Statistics is record Callback_Entries : Interfaces.Unsigned_64; Callbacks_Coalesced : Interfaces.Unsigned_64; Notifications_Delivered : Interfaces.Unsigned_64; Callbacks_After_Stop : Interfaces.Unsigned_64; Pending, Stopped : Boolean; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Unsubscribe
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Unsubscribe
text: procedure Unsubscribe (VA : in out Virtual_Aperture'Class; Object : in out Subscription); -- Copy all counters and flags under one native lock without consuming signals. -- @param Object Subscription with a local handle, possibly stopped. -- @return Consistent signal statistics; no provider query or state guarantee. -- Live matching VA required. Stops first, then removes the exact key once; -- repeated calls return the cached outcome, including failure. May block in -- provider removal; no callback-quiescence guarantee or bridge drain wait. procedure Unsubscribe (VA : in out Virtual_Aperture'Class; Object : in out Subscription);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Wait_For_Change
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Notifications.Wait_For_Change
text: procedure Wait_For_Change (Object : Subscription; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural); -- Wait observed logical stop; distinct from timeout or query status values. -- Zero polls; maps native timeout to C2.Timeout_Error. Stop takes priority -- over pending changes and raises Subscription_Stopped. procedure Wait_For_Change (Object : Subscription; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Queries.Cached_Waveform_Supported
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Queries.Cached_Waveform_Supported

A closed owner or native/provider failure raises -- Provider Error; no status enum is read or decoded. -- @param Object Live claimed VA; externally serialize with all same-VA calls, including -- Close. -- @return Provider-returned VA definition ID, not a VA instance index. -- Required live capability calls; False is successful provider data. function Cached_Waveform_Supported (Object : Virtual_Aperture'Class) return Boolean;

Native failures raise -- Provider Error. -- @param Object Live claimed VA; externally serialize with all same-VA calls, including -- Close. -- @param Face_ID Provider face ID forwarded unchanged, not a list position. -- @return Independent IDs in provider vector order, including duplicates and empty -- results. function Count (Value : Instance_ID_List) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Queries.Instance_ID

No comparison against the requested identity or separate live queries is imposed. -- Closed owners, native failures and unknown status enums raise Provider Error; reported -- Failed or Degraded states are successful data. -- @param Object Live claimed VA; externally serialize with all same-VA calls, including -- Close. -- @param Instance_ID Requested provider instance ID; need not equal the returned report -- ID. -- @return Independent report, retaining empty LF groups and provider-returned identity. function Instance_ID (Value : Instance_Status_Report) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Queries.Instance_ID_List
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Queries.Instance_ID_List

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Queries.Instance_Status_Report
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Queries.Instance_Status_Report
text: type Instance_Status_Report is private; -- Read LF status in provider vector order. Ada position 1 corresponds to provider vector -- index 0, not a new provider identity. -- @param Value Ada-owned copied value; no provider access or retained provider owner. -- @param Index Positive one-based position; beyond the stored count raises -- Constraint Error. -- @return Stored status; no live query or execution confirmation. -- Copy of one provider-returned report, including empty LF vectors. Its -- returned ID is authoritative and need not match the requested ID. Groups -- use ascending type-ID order; vector positions are provider LF ordering. type Instance_Status_Report is private;

label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Queries.Local_Function_Group_At

label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Queries.Local_Function_Type_Count

Closed owners, native failures and unknown status -- enums raise Provider Error; reported Failed or Degraded states are successful data. -- @param Object Live claimed VA; externally serialize with all same-VA calls, including -- Close. -- @return Current provider-reported VA status. function Query_Instance_Status (Object : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Instance_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32) return Status_Kind;

Copies survive VA/C2 -- closure. function Snapshot_Instance_Status_Report (Object : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Instance_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32) return Instance_Status_Report;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Queries.Status_Kind
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Queries.Status_Kind
text: type Status_Kind is (None, Operational, Degraded, Failed); -- Fresh explicit synchronous VA queries and Ada-owned snapshots. These operations are -- required upstream, including the capability Booleans; LF-specific conditional queries -- live in Local Functions. Separate calls have no atomicity or consistency guarantee and -- do not consume VA notifications. Query success is distinct from the returned status or -- False capability data. type Status_Kind is (None, Operational, Degraded, Failed);

Submission checks UTF-8. -- @param Config Configuration whose capability list is extended. -- @param Value Capability identity; not a Job byte-vector identity. type Virtual_Aperture_Request is tagged limited private;

label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Virtual_Aperture_Result

label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Wait (overload 1/2)
text: function Wait (Request : Virtual_Aperture_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Virtual_Aperture_Result; -- Copy the full cached diagnostic. Native malformed provider text is replaced -- by a fixed diagnostic; long failure descriptions are not silently truncated. -- @param Result Copied terminal request result. -- @return Owned diagnostic string, empty on successful creation. function Wait (Request : Virtual_Aperture_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Virtual_Aperture_Result;

Long descriptions are retrieved without silent truncation. -- @param Result Copied terminal Job request result. -- @return Owned diagnostic string, empty on successful creation. function Wait (Request : Job_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Job_Result;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Wait_Job_Status
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Wait_Job_Status
text: function Wait_Job_Status (Object : Job; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Job_Status; -- Synchronously invoke provider finalize once, indicating that Job population -- is finished; hand its future to one native completion worker. Normal return -- means invocation/worker setup succeeded, not future completion or physical -- RF activation. Once invocation is attempted, repeated success returns -- normally and repeated synchronous failure raises the cached provider error -- without resending. An invalid future also raises a provider error. Bridge -- allocation failure before invocation does not consume the provider attempt. -- Cancel attempted first prohibits a new Finalize, even if Cancel returned -- False or raised; an already attempted Finalize remains repeatable from -- cache after Cancel. Future exceptions are reported by status Wait instead. -- Post-invocation worker failure retains future/provider/library state. -- @param Object Open Job; externally serialize all same-Job calls and Close. function Wait_Job_Status (Object : Job; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Job_Status;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Buffer_I16
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Buffer_I16
text: function Waveform_Buffer_I16 (Samples : Waveform_Sample_I16_Array) return Modulation_Config; -- Select kind 6 with signed 8-bit sample storage and fixed ComplexCartesian format. Copy pairs in caller index order. Each active definition per Add receives a fresh nonnull native shared vector, even when empty; native copies share that allocation, not Ada caller storage. Native vector max size and span arithmetic limit accepted sizes. No DMA, zero-copy lifetime, transfer or physical emission is promised. -- @param Samples Copied ordered complex pairs, including empty. -- @return Owned 8-bit WaveformBuffer configuration. function Waveform_Buffer_I16 (Samples : Waveform_Sample_I16_Array) return Modulation_Config;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Buffer_I8
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Buffer_I8
text: function Waveform_Buffer_I8 (Samples : Waveform_Sample_I8_Array) return Modulation_Config; -- Ordered signed 16-bit Cartesian pairs with Positive indices and arbitrary lower bound. -- Null arrays are accepted; counts mean complex pairs, not bytes or individual components. -- Owned caller values. Each Add copies into fresh native storage; native -- copies of one submitted buffer share that storage. No timing/execution -- guarantee is implied, including for empty Cartesian buffers. function Waveform_Buffer_I8 (Samples : Waveform_Sample_I8_Array) return Modulation_Config;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Pattern_List
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Pattern_List
text: type Waveform_Pattern_List is private; -- Owned ordered profile-index/iteration steps, initially empty; copies are independent. -- No chip duration is stored in a step: duration belongs to the selected profile. type Waveform_Pattern_List is private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Profile
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Profile
text: type Waveform_Profile is private; -- Nonnegative signed 32-bit profile index, 0 through Integer 32 Last. -- Must fit native int and refer to a profile in the same CustomWaveform at Add; -- there is no -1 sentinel for an inner waveform step. type Waveform_Profile is private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Profile_Index
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Profile_Index
text: subtype Waveform_Profile_Index is Interfaces.Integer_32 range 0 .. Interfaces.Integer_32'Last; -- Ordered owned definitions, initially empty; copies retain independent Ada values. -- References are zero-based and resolve only in the same interval active table. -- No prior Add, another interval or provider registry supplies missing entries. -- Owned configuration values only, not executable waveform validation. -- Degrees stay degrees; false update flags retain their numeric values. subtype Waveform_Profile_Index is Interfaces.Integer_32 range 0 .. Interfaces.Integer_32'Last;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Profile_Table
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Profile_Table
text: type Waveform_Profile_Table is private; -- Owned profile values: zero femtoseconds, six zero double scalars and six False update flags by default. -- Phase/delta phase remain degrees, offsets/deltas Hz, slope the pinned HzSec -- quantity. False update flags retain their numeric fields. Signed zero and -- nonfinite classification survive native-double conversion, not NaN payload bits. -- No normalization, amplitude clamping, timing synthesis or update execution. type Waveform_Profile_Table is private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Sample_I16
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Sample_I16
text: type Waveform_Sample_I16 is record Real, Imag : Interfaces.Integer_16; end record; -- One Cartesian complex pair with signed 8-bit components; no scaling or clipping. -- @field Real Real (I) component, full signed 8-bit integer domain. -- @field Imag Imaginary (Q) component, full signed 8-bit integer domain. type Waveform_Sample_I16 is record Real, Imag : Interfaces.Integer_16; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Sample_I16_Array
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Sample_I16_Array
text: type Waveform_Sample_I16_Array is array (Positive range <>) of Waveform_Sample_I16; -- Ordered signed 8-bit Cartesian pairs with Positive indices and arbitrary lower bound. -- Null arrays are accepted; counts mean complex pairs, not bytes or individual components. type Waveform_Sample_I16_Array is array (Positive range <>) of Waveform_Sample_I16;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Sample_I8
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Sample_I8
text: type Waveform_Sample_I8 is record Real, Imag : Interfaces.Integer_8; end record; -- Replace all six descriptors through a new stream value; wrong kind raises Constraint Error without changing Config. Same numeric-only ownership and Add-time size t validation as the constructor; no data is transferred. -- @param Config Owned WaveformStream (kind 7) required. -- @param Endpoint_ID Full unsigned 64-bit endpoint identity; no existence query. -- @param Start_Address Full unsigned 64-bit numeric descriptor, not an Ada access value or bridge-owned pointer. -- @param Num_Bytes Unsigned 64-bit bytes per iteration; must fit native size t at Add (checked Ada conversion/round trip). Zero is accepted. -- @param Sample_Format Sample shape, default ComplexCartesian in the constructor. -- @param Item_Format Numeric item descriptor, default FixedPointSigned in the constructor. -- @param Repeat_Mode Provider repeat policy, default RepeatFromTop in the constructor. type Waveform_Sample_I8 is record Real, Imag : Interfaces.Integer_8; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Sample_I8_Array
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Sample_I8_Array
text: type Waveform_Sample_I8_Array is array (Positive range <>) of Waveform_Sample_I8; -- One Cartesian complex pair with signed 16-bit components; no scaling or clipping. -- @field Real Real (I) component, full signed 16-bit integer domain. -- @field Imag Imaginary (Q) component, full signed 16-bit integer domain. type Waveform_Sample_I8_Array is array (Positive range <>) of Waveform_Sample_I8;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Stream
label: AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Waveform_Stream
text: function Waveform_Stream (Endpoint_ID, Start_Address, Num_Bytes : Interfaces.Unsigned_64; Sample_Format : Stream_Sample_Format := Stream_Complex_Cartesian; Item_Format : Stream_Item_Format := Stream_Fixed_Point_Signed; Repeat_Mode : Stream_Repeat_Mode := Stream_Repeat_From_Top) return Modulation_Config; -- Scalar descriptor only: numeric address, not a pointer. No endpoint or -- backing memory is acquired, checked, owned or transferred by this API. function Waveform_Stream (Endpoint_ID, Start_Address, Num_Bytes : Interfaces.Unsigned_64; Sample_Format : Stream_Sample_Format := Stream_Complex_Cartesian; Item_Format : Stream_Item_Format := Stream_Fixed_Point_Signed; Repeat_Mode : Stream_Repeat_Mode := Stream_Repeat_From_Top) return Modulation_Config;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Data_MEL
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Data_MEL
text: type Data_MEL is limited private; -- RF DataMEL ownership and copied MFA, face, installation and transmit-power -- characteristics. This provider family is independent of an IR Session. -- Capability reports do not demonstrate active RF transmission or real -- hardware qualification. Child packages provide separately scoped services. -- Serialize operations on one DataMEL owner against each other and Close. -- Snapshot values contain no live provider reference and may outlive it. type Data_MEL is limited private;

label: AMS.MEL.RF.Face_ID

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Is_Open
text: function Is_Open (Object : Data_MEL) return Boolean; -- Load a provider library and call its RF DataMEL factory, not IR factories. -- Strings are passed as UTF-8 bytes without transcoding; this open path does -- not validate UTF-8. Compatible provider C++ ABI remains required behind the facade. -- @param Library_Path Shared-library path containing the RF factory. -- @param Configuration Text passed to the provider factory; its syntax and -- interpretation are provider-defined, not a bridge configuration schema. -- @return Limited owner of the acquired RF DataMEL. -- @exception Constraint_Error Either input contains an embedded NUL, rejected -- before loading the provider. -- @exception Provider_Error Native validation, loading, symbol lookup or -- factory acquisition fails, including a null factory result. function Is_Open (Object : Data_MEL) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Physical_Data
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Physical_Data
text: type Physical_Data is private; -- Delegate duration quantization to the provider's MFA information method. -- The bridge applies no rounding, clamping or scheduler-resolution arithmetic; -- a universal rounding direction is not established by the pinned interface. -- @param Data Open RF DataMEL used to acquire the provider MFA information. -- @param Femtoseconds Unquantized signed 64-bit duration in femtoseconds, -- passed unchanged, including negative or zero input. -- @return Provider-quantized signed 64-bit femtosecond count, copied unchanged. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed owner, unavailable MFA information or -- provider/native failure during quantization. -- Ada-owned point-in-time value; no native/provider handle survives return. type Physical_Data is private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Assigned_Data_Format
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Assigned_Data_Format

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Claim
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Claim
text: function Claim (Request : Create_Request'Class) return Endpoint; -- Unique limited controlled owner of a claimed provider receive endpoint and the transferred -- DataMEL child claim. Default initialization is closed. Endpoint ID and assigned format are -- cached after successful provider creation, not queried live. Explicit Close reports -- failures; finalization attempts non-raising cleanup. Keep operations externally serialized -- against owner destruction. function Claim (Request : Create_Request'Class) return Endpoint;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Close
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Close (overload 1/3)
text: procedure Close (Request : in out Create_Request); -- Store settings selecting AMS VITA Extra Large (7); no provider call or allocation of a -- receive region occurs here. Zero region size is forwarded if representable; the bridge -- imposes no positive-region or sample-storage-size relationship. -- @param Region_Size_Bytes Requested provider region size in bytes, unchanged; Submit requires -- it to fit native size t. -- @param Queue_Capacity Positive maximum number of queued copied products; a full queue drops -- incoming products, not older entries. -- @param Max_Samples_Per_Event Positive maximum packet-object count per callback, not bytes or -- decoded IQ samples. -- @return Copied configuration for later Submit. procedure Close (Request : in out Create_Request);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Close
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Close (overload 2/3)
text: procedure Close (Object : in out Endpoint); -- Read the cached assigned provider format. Creation checks equality with the requested -- supported format before callback registration. -- @param Object Endpoint containing the cached format, which remains stored after Close. -- @return One of formats 0 through 7 after successful Claim; no conversion or broader upstream -- support is implied. procedure Close (Object : in out Endpoint);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Close
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Close (overload 3/3)
text: procedure Close (Value : in out Event); -- Copy signed 16-bit scalar samples from a selected Direct INT16 event into independent Ada -- storage. Uses the same open-event and exact-format checks as borrowed access: wrong format -- raises Constraint Error even for empty events; a closed event raises Provider Error. -- Serialize copying against Event Close. No conversion, resampling or DSP is performed. -- @param Value Open event of exactly Direct INT16 format. -- @return One-based Ada array (null range if empty) whose values survive Event closure. procedure Close (Value : in out Event);

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Complex_I16
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Complex_I16
text: type Complex_I16 is record Real : Interfaces.Integer_16; Imag : Interfaces.Integer_16; end record with Convention => C; -- Copy all counters under the native callback-state lock without consuming products. Every -- counter saturates; queue-full drops are distinct from malformed products and allocation -- failures. Closed/invalid native ownership raises Provider Error. -- @param Object Open endpoint whose bridge counters are sampled. -- @return Independent diagnostic counter snapshot. type Complex_I16 is record Real : Interfaces.Integer_16; Imag : Interfaces.Integer_16; end record -- C-compatible Cartesian I/Q value with two signed 16-bit integer components. name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Counter
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Counter
text: type Counter is mod 2**64 with Size => 64; -- Idempotently consume the endpoint owner. Native logical closure discards queued products and -- wakes receivers before draining admitted bridge callback bodies; only then is the provider -- endpoint destroyed and its parent claim released. This drain is not provider-wide callback -- quiescence. Late callbacks take the stopped path before payload access. The permanent -- callable/state/DSO shell is not freed at Close. Failure to establish safe drain retains -- endpoint and claim; throwing parent shutdown permanently retains its provider graph. -- Delivered Events remain usable. -- @param Object Endpoint owner to close; externally serialize wrapper destruction against -- other operations. Explicit failures raise Provider Error; finalization does not propagate -- them. type Counter is mod 2**64 with Size => 64;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Is_Open (overload 2/3)
text: function Is_Open (Object : Endpoint) return Boolean; -- Transfer successful unclaimed creation to exactly one endpoint and register its data-ready -- callback. Pending Claim raises Timeout Error; failed, already-claimed or registration-failed -- requests raise Provider Error. A registration failure is cached and is not retried. Callback -- state is ready before registration, allowing synchronous callbacks. The exact registered -- std::function lvalue, callback state and provider DSO remain permanently retained: providers -- may keep a reference or move the callable. This shell owns neither DataMEL nor endpoint nor -- event payloads. -- @param Request Open successful request; only one Claim may succeed. -- @return Unique open endpoint with the requested format verified against the assigned format; -- not proof of reception. function Is_Open (Object : Endpoint) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Is_Open
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Is_Open (overload 3/3)
text: function Is_Open (Value : Event) return Boolean; -- Transfer the oldest complete queued event to one owner, copying checked metadata to Ada -- without a second bulk payload copy. Queue capacity is bounded and drops incoming products -- when full. Malformed or unsupported callbacks and copy-allocation failures publish nothing -- and are counted separately. Native stop raises Stream Stopped in preference to queued -- delivery; no ready product raises Timeout Error without stopping reception. Invalid native -- views raise Provider Error and the partially constructed owner is finalized. -- @param Object Open endpoint; serialize public wrapper destruction against operations. -- @param Timeout_Milliseconds Native wait in milliseconds; default zero polls without blocking -- for a product. -- @return Unique copied event; sample or packet data remain owned until Event Close, -- independently of provider buffer reuse. function Is_Open (Value : Event) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.MEL_Protocol_Version_ID
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.MEL_Protocol_Version_ID
text: function MEL_Protocol_Version_ID (Value : Product_Metadata) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32; -- Ordinary copied observation metadata with Ada-owned ordered vectors; no provider object, -- live query or command is retained. Copies survive Event, Endpoint and DataMEL closure. Safe -- Ada Submit and Receive use native v9 for all formats 0..7, adding stabilization to v8 -- association semantics; these profile numbers are not new formats. Older native profiles -- remain frozen and reject nonempty metadata they cannot expose. User-defined std::any content -- and full ReceiveEvent objects remain unsupported and reject callbacks rather than being -- silently dropped. Stored identifiers and pointings do not prove physical RF provenance or -- commanded-event validity. function MEL_Protocol_Version_ID (Value : Product_Metadata) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

Created and Failed are -- normal outcomes; timeout and provider/bridge exceptions are raised instead. Failure text is -- copied, with a fallback for invalid provider UTF-8; unknown rejection codes and -- null/mismatched endpoints are diagnosed rather than accepted. function Outcome (Result : Create_Result) return Create_Outcome;

Cached ID, format and Ada metadata remain stored; previously returned metadata -- and explicit payload copies remain independent. Externally serialize all event access with -- closure. Automatic finalization attempts the same release without propagating exceptions. -- @param Value Event owner consumed; no provider sample buffer or endpoint is destroyed here. type Packet_Byte_Array is array (Natural range <>) of Interfaces.Unsigned_8 with Convention => C;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Receive
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Receive
text: function Receive (Object : Endpoint'Class; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Event; -- Unique limited controlled owner of one immutable native copied callback product, plus -- ordinary Ada metadata copies. Default initialization is closed. Provider buffers are read -- and copied before callback return and are never retained as borrowed event data. A delivered -- event survives endpoint and DataMEL closure without retaining their provider objects. -- Explicit Close releases the event; automatic finalization is non-raising. Serialize access -- against Event Close/finalization; borrowed views are not unrestricted cross-task references. function Receive (Object : Endpoint'Class; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Event;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Receive_Event_Association_Count
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Receive_Event_Association_Count
text: function Receive_Event_Association_Count (Value : Product_Metadata) return Natural; -- Distinguish absent optional associations from present-empty and present-nonempty values. For -- v9 VITA events a present vector must match packet-object count, so present-empty is valid -- only for zero packets; absence remains allowed at any count. Direct/complex events permit -- absent or present-empty only. -- @param Value Copied association presence and IDs; no provider query. -- @return True when the provider optional had a value, even if its copied vector is empty. function Receive_Event_Association_Count (Value : Product_Metadata) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Receive_Event_Association_ID_At
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Receive_Event_Association_ID_At

Zero alone cannot distinguish -- absence from present-empty. VITA present cardinality equals packet-object count; -- Direct/Complex nonempty associations reject the whole callback. -- @param Value Metadata with independent Ada association storage. -- @return Number of stored association IDs, preserving order and duplicates. function Receive_Event_Association_ID_At (Value : Product_Metadata; Index : Positive) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Receive_Event_Associations_Present
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Receive_Event_Associations_Present
text: function Receive_Event_Associations_Present (Value : Product_Metadata) return Boolean; -- Return an independent copy of one AMS VITA Extra Large packet, preserving all validated -- serialized bytes in original order, not unused capacity. Uses the same selected-format, -- open-event and one-based index checks as borrowed packet access. Wrong format or invalid -- index raises Constraint Error, including empty events; closed event raises Provider Error. -- Serialize copying against Event Close. Mock/header byte fidelity does not establish physical -- reception or positive Squall VITA delivery. -- @param Value Open AMS VITA Extra Large event. -- @param Index One-based packet-object index, never a byte offset or provider identifier. -- @return One-based Ada byte array of actual validated packet length, 32..32768 bytes; -- survives Event closure. function Receive_Event_Associations_Present (Value : Product_Metadata) return Boolean;

Unlike active stabilization UTC fields, this -- legacy field has no added bridge canonical-fraction validation; do not infer such validation -- from the v9 profile. -- @param Value Copied metadata holding the provider time representation. -- @return Exact signed 64-bit fractional femtosecond count alongside the integral seconds. function Rx_Stream_ID_Count (Value : Product_Metadata) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Statistics
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.Statistics
text: function Statistics (Object : Endpoint) return Counters; -- Consistent copied native queue/callback counters; these are bridge observations, not RF -- performance measurements. -- @field Callbacks_Received All bridge callback entries, including late callbacks after -- logical closure. -- @field Products_Queued Complete products successfully appended to the queue; cumulative, not -- current queue depth. -- @field Products_Dropped_Queue_Full Incoming complete products discarded because the bounded -- queue was full; older queued products remain. -- @field Malformed_Or_Unsupported Callbacks rejected for invalid metadata, wrong alternatives, -- oversize counts or unsupported content; no partial product is queued. -- @field Allocation_Failures Callback copy or queue-allocation failures; no partial event is -- published. -- @field Callbacks_After_Close Entries observed after logical Close, or admitted copies that -- lost publication to Close. function Statistics (Object : Endpoint) return Counters;

Uses the same open-event and exact-format checks as borrowed access: wrong format -- raises Constraint Error even for empty events; a closed event raises Provider Error. -- Serialize copying against Event Close. No conversion, resampling or DSP is performed. -- @param Value Open event of exactly Direct INT8 format. -- @return One-based Ada array (null range if empty) whose values survive Event closure. procedure With_Direct_Samples_I16 (Value : Event; Process : not null access procedure (Samples : Direct_I16_Array));

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.With_Samples
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.With_Samples
text: procedure With_Samples (Value : Event; Process : not null access procedure (Samples : Complex_I16_Array)); -- Read the stored element count, not a byte count. Complex formats count Cartesian pairs, -- direct formats count signed scalars, and VITA formats count packet objects, not decoded -- samples or payload bytes. Event Close resets this count to zero. -- @param Value Event whose stored payload count is read. -- @return Number of active payload elements stored in the event. -- Borrows the native event payload: no additional bulk copy. Valid only -- during Process, while the Event remains open and is not concurrently closed. procedure With_Samples (Value : Event; Process : not null access procedure (Samples : Complex_I16_Array));

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.With_Samples_I8
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.With_Samples_I8
text: procedure With_Samples_I8 (Value : Event; Process : not null access procedure (Samples : Complex_I8_Array)); -- Copy signed 16-bit Cartesian pairs from a selected Complex INT16 event into independent Ada -- storage. No conversion, resampling or DSP is performed. -- @param Value Open event of exactly Complex INT16 format. -- @return One-based Ada array (null range if empty) whose values survive Event closure. -- Width-specific access raises Constraint_Error for the wrong format, -- even for an empty event. Borrowing requires external serialization -- with Close, just like With_Samples; copies are independent Ada owners. procedure With_Samples_I8 (Value : Event; Process : not null access procedure (Samples : Complex_I8_Array));

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.With_VITA_Extra_Large_Packet
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Product_Rx.With_VITA_Extra_Large_Packet
text: procedure With_VITA_Extra_Large_Packet (Value : Event; Index : Positive; Process : not null access procedure (Bytes : Packet_Byte_Array)); -- Count AMS VITA Extra Large packet objects, not payload bytes or IQ samples. The selected -- native packet class has 32768-byte storage capacity and at most 32736 payload bytes. The -- pinned AMS VITA view must validate each packet before its declared size is read: accepted -- serialized length is 32 through 32768 bytes in multiples of four. Any malformed packet -- rejects the entire callback, including earlier valid packets, with no partial event -- publication. Wrong format raises Constraint Error even on an empty event; closed event -- raises Provider Error. -- @param Value Open event selected as AMS VITA Extra Large; no provider call or decoding. -- @return Packet-object count, including zero for a correctly selected empty event. procedure With_VITA_Extra_Large_Packet (Value : Event; Index : Positive; Process : not null access procedure (Bytes : Packet_Byte_Array));

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Query_Provider_Version
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Query_Provider_Version
text: function Query_Provider_Version (Object : Data_MEL) return AMS.MEL.Provider_Version; -- Consume the public owner; closing an already closed owner is harmless. -- Native shutdown is deferred while asynchronous create-request/endpoint -- children retain claims. Otherwise shutdown precedes provider destruction. -- Throwing shutdown retains the provider graph rather than unloading unsafe -- code; registered callback code can also remain retained for process life. -- This is neither cancellation nor destruction of all independent children. -- @param Object Owner to close; serialize against operations on this object. -- @exception Provider_Error Native cleanup or immediate shutdown fails; -- the public handle is consumed even when shutdown reports failure. function Query_Provider_Version (Object : Data_MEL) return AMS.MEL.Provider_Version;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Reported_Num_Faces
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Reported_Num_Faces
text: function Reported_Num_Faces (Value : MFA_Info) return Interfaces.Unsigned_64; -- Copy global and per-face characteristics, then release native snapshot storage. -- @param Object Open RF DataMEL, serialized against other owner operations. -- @return Independent Ada-owned capability snapshot usable after closure. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed owner, unavailable MFA information or -- invalid native spans/booleans, unrepresentable counts or provider/copy failure. function Reported_Num_Faces (Value : MFA_Info) return Interfaces.Unsigned_64;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Requires_Endpoint_Association
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Requires_Endpoint_Association
text: function Requires_Endpoint_Association (Value : Face_Info) return Boolean; -- Read the provider-reported transmit capability for this face. -- @param Value Ada-owned face-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return True if transmit is reported supported, not evidence of active transmission -- or qualification on real RF hardware. function Requires_Endpoint_Association (Value : Face_Info) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Rx_Frequency_Range_At
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Rx_Frequency_Range_At
text: function Rx_Frequency_Range_At (Value : Face_Info; Index : Positive) return Frequency_Range; -- Count this face's reported receive carrier-frequency ranges. -- @param Value Ada-owned face-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Number of copied ranges in provider vector order, possibly zero. function Rx_Frequency_Range_At (Value : Face_Info; Index : Positive) return Frequency_Range;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Rx_Frequency_Range_Count
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Rx_Frequency_Range_Count
text: function Rx_Frequency_Range_Count (Value : Face_Info) return Natural; -- Read the minimum gap between a receive event and subsequent receive event. -- @param Value Ada-owned face-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Provider-reported signed femtoseconds for RX then RX ordering. function Rx_Frequency_Range_Count (Value : Face_Info) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Rx_Rx_Switching_Time_FS
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Rx_Rx_Switching_Time_FS
text: function Rx_Rx_Switching_Time_FS (Value : Face_Info) return Interfaces.Integer_64; -- Read the minimum gap between a transmit event and subsequent transmit event. -- @param Value Ada-owned face-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Provider-reported signed femtoseconds for TX then TX ordering. function Rx_Rx_Switching_Time_FS (Value : Face_Info) return Interfaces.Integer_64;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Rx_Tx_Switching_Time_FS
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Rx_Tx_Switching_Time_FS
text: function Rx_Tx_Switching_Time_FS (Value : Face_Info) return Interfaces.Integer_64; -- Read the minimum gap from a transmit event to a subsequent receive event. -- @param Value Ada-owned face-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Provider-reported signed femtoseconds for TX then RX ordering. function Rx_Tx_Switching_Time_FS (Value : Face_Info) return Interfaces.Integer_64;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Sample_Frequency_Range_At
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Sample_Frequency_Range_At
text: function Sample_Frequency_Range_At (Value : Face_Info; Index : Positive) return Frequency_Range; -- Count this face's reported sampling-frequency ranges. -- @param Value Ada-owned face-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Number of copied ranges in provider vector order, possibly zero. function Sample_Frequency_Range_At (Value : Face_Info; Index : Positive) return Frequency_Range;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Sample_Frequency_Range_Count
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Sample_Frequency_Range_Count
text: function Sample_Frequency_Range_Count (Value : Face_Info) return Natural; -- Copy one transmit carrier-frequency range in stored order. -- @param Value Ada-owned source snapshot, independent of provider lifetime. -- @param Index Positive one-based position no greater than the stored count. -- @return Copied provider transmit bounds in hertz, unchanged. -- @exception Constraint_Error Index exceeds the stored collection length. function Sample_Frequency_Range_Count (Value : Face_Info) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Scheduler_Resolution_FS
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Scheduler_Resolution_FS
text: function Scheduler_Resolution_FS (Value : MFA_Info) return Interfaces.Integer_64; -- Read the provider's indication that open additions are included. -- @param Value Ada-owned MFA-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Copied open-additions flag. The pinned interface gives no further generic -- feature inventory; this is not a bridge implementation-completeness claim. function Scheduler_Resolution_FS (Value : MFA_Info) return Interfaces.Integer_64;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Snapshot_MFA_Info
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Snapshot_MFA_Info
text: function Snapshot_MFA_Info (Object : Data_MEL) return MFA_Info; -- Ada-owned point-in-time MFA characteristics, copied from several provider -- queries. Not a live reference or a promise of an atomic provider-wide view. -- Reported face count is kept separately from the copied face collection. function Snapshot_MFA_Info (Object : Data_MEL) return MFA_Info;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Snapshot_Physical_Data
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Snapshot_Physical_Data
text: function Snapshot_Physical_Data (Data : Data_MEL; Face_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32) return Physical_Data; -- Ada-owned point-in-time face dimensions and installation geometry. No -- native/provider handle survives a snapshot return. Scalars are copied -- without coordinate conversion, normalization or physical-range validation. function Snapshot_Physical_Data (Data : Data_MEL; Face_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32) return Physical_Data;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Snapshot_Tx_Power_Mode
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Snapshot_Tx_Power_Mode
text: function Snapshot_Tx_Power_Mode (Data : Data_MEL; Face_ID, Power_Mode_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32) return Tx_Power_Mode; -- Copy the provider's complete reported mode collection for one face. -- The query does not first gate on the face's supports-transmit flag. -- @param Data Open RF DataMEL, serialized against other owner operations. -- @param Face_ID Provider-assigned face identifier passed unchanged. -- @return Ada-owned ordered modes and nested ranges; an empty list is valid. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed owner, missing MFA information or -- provider/native query, representation or copy failure. function Snapshot_Tx_Power_Mode (Data : Data_MEL; Face_ID, Power_Mode_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32) return Tx_Power_Mode;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Snapshot_Tx_Power_Modes
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Snapshot_Tx_Power_Modes
text: function Snapshot_Tx_Power_Modes (Data : Data_MEL; Face_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32) return Tx_Power_Mode_List; -- Ada-owned ordered mode snapshots; default construction is an empty list. -- Provider order and duplicate mode IDs are preserved without normalization. function Snapshot_Tx_Power_Modes (Data : Data_MEL; Face_ID : Interfaces.Unsigned_32) return Tx_Power_Mode_List;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Supported_Data_Format_At
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Supported_Data_Format_At
text: function Supported_Data_Format_At (Value : MFA_Info; Index : Positive) return Job_Data_Format; -- Count the copied provider-supported format identifiers. -- @param Value Ada-owned MFA-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Number of entries copied from the provider set, not implemented Ada APIs. function Supported_Data_Format_At (Value : MFA_Info; Index : Positive) return Job_Data_Format;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Supported_Data_Format_Count
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Supported_Data_Format_Count
text: function Supported_Data_Format_Count (Value : MFA_Info) return Natural; -- Read the provider constraint on JobInterval user-defined context size. -- @param Value Ada-owned MFA-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Maximum reported bytes, not storage allocated or automatically registered -- by this package. function Supported_Data_Format_Count (Value : MFA_Info) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Supports_Receive
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Supports_Receive
text: function Supports_Receive (Value : Face_Info) return Boolean; -- Read the face identifier in this copied capability record. -- @param Value Ada-owned face-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Provider-assigned face ID, not its one-based position in the snapshot. function Supports_Receive (Value : Face_Info) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Supports_Transmit
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Supports_Transmit
text: function Supports_Transmit (Value : Face_Info) return Boolean; -- Read the provider-reported receive capability for this face. -- @param Value Ada-owned face-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return True if the provider reports receive support; not proof of active collection. function Supports_Transmit (Value : Face_Info) return Boolean;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Attenuation_Step_Size
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Attenuation_Step_Size
text: function Tx_Attenuation_Step_Size (Value : Tx_Power_Mode) return Long_Float; -- Read the maximum available attenuation at the snapshot time. -- @param Value Ada-owned transmit-mode snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Provider scalar, potentially changed by runtime calibration. The pinned -- declaration specifies no attenuation unit; the bridge invents none. function Tx_Attenuation_Step_Size (Value : Tx_Power_Mode) return Long_Float;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Frequency_Range_At
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Frequency_Range_At (overload 1/2)
text: function Tx_Frequency_Range_At (Value : Tx_Power_Mode; Index : Positive) return Frequency_Range; -- Count the reported frequency ranges valid for this transmit mode. -- @param Value Ada-owned transmit-mode snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Number of stored ranges; no sorting, merging or deduplication. function Tx_Frequency_Range_At (Value : Tx_Power_Mode; Index : Positive) return Frequency_Range;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Frequency_Range_At
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Frequency_Range_At (overload 2/2)
text: function Tx_Frequency_Range_At (Value : Face_Info; Index : Positive) return Frequency_Range; -- Count this face's reported transmit carrier-frequency ranges. -- @param Value Ada-owned face-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Number of copied ranges in provider vector order, possibly zero. function Tx_Frequency_Range_At (Value : Face_Info; Index : Positive) return Frequency_Range;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Frequency_Range_Count
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Frequency_Range_Count (overload 1/2)
text: function Tx_Frequency_Range_Count (Value : Tx_Power_Mode) return Natural; -- Read the power-level identifier associated with this mode. -- @param Value Ada-owned transmit-mode snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Unsigned provider level; zero is reserved upstream as the default level. -- This is distinct from the mode ID and is not a watt or dBm measurement. function Tx_Frequency_Range_Count (Value : Tx_Power_Mode) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Frequency_Range_Count
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Frequency_Range_Count (overload 2/2)
text: function Tx_Frequency_Range_Count (Value : Face_Info) return Natural; -- Copy one receive carrier-frequency range in stored order. -- @param Value Ada-owned source snapshot, independent of provider lifetime. -- @param Index Positive one-based position no greater than the stored count. -- @return Copied provider receive bounds in hertz, unchanged. -- @exception Constraint_Error Index exceeds the stored collection length. function Tx_Frequency_Range_Count (Value : Face_Info) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Power_Level
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Power_Level
text: function Tx_Power_Level (Value : Tx_Power_Mode) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32; -- Read whether the mode specifies linear rather than compressed operation. -- @param Value Ada-owned transmit-mode snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return True for linear operation, False for compressed operation. function Tx_Power_Level (Value : Tx_Power_Mode) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Power_Mode
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Power_Mode
text: type Tx_Power_Mode is private; -- Ada-owned face capability/timing snapshot, including provider-assigned ID -- and ordered frequency-range collections. It is not a live face resource. type Tx_Power_Mode is private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Power_Mode_At
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Power_Mode_At
text: function Tx_Power_Mode_At (Value : Tx_Power_Mode_List; Index : Positive) return Tx_Power_Mode; -- Count the mode snapshots in provider collection order. -- @param Value Ada-owned mode-list snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Number of stored entries, including duplicate IDs; zero for an empty list. function Tx_Power_Mode_At (Value : Tx_Power_Mode_List; Index : Positive) return Tx_Power_Mode;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Power_Mode_Count
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Power_Mode_Count
text: function Tx_Power_Mode_Count (Value : Tx_Power_Mode_List) return Natural; -- Invoke the provider's direct mode query, not a search in a cached list. -- Returned IDs are provider-authoritative and need not match the requested ID; -- no generic not-found convention is specified by the pinned method. -- @param Data Open RF DataMEL, serialized against other owner operations. -- @param Face_ID Provider-assigned face identifier passed unchanged. -- @param Power_Mode_ID Requested provider mode ID, not a universal power level. -- @return Ada-owned mode returned by the provider, including its actual ID. -- @exception Provider_Error Closed owner, missing MFA information, failed -- query/copy or a direct native snapshot not containing exactly one mode. function Tx_Power_Mode_Count (Value : Tx_Power_Mode_List) return Natural;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Power_Mode_ID
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Power_Mode_ID
text: function Tx_Power_Mode_ID (Value : Tx_Power_Mode) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32; -- Copy one mode in stored order. -- @param Value Ada-owned source snapshot, independent of provider lifetime. -- @param Index Positive one-based position no greater than the stored count. -- @return Ada-owned mode with copied nested frequency ranges. -- @exception Constraint_Error Index exceeds the stored collection length. function Tx_Power_Mode_ID (Value : Tx_Power_Mode) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Power_Mode_List
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Power_Mode_List
text: type Tx_Power_Mode_List is private; -- Copied characteristics of a provider-assigned transmit-power mode. -- Upstream warns that using a mode outside its stated characteristics, -- explicitly its frequency ranges, may damage hardware. This value reports -- limits; obtaining it does not validate a future transmit Job against them. type Tx_Power_Mode_List is private;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Rx_Switching_Time_FS
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Rx_Switching_Time_FS
text: function Tx_Rx_Switching_Time_FS (Value : Face_Info) return Interfaces.Integer_64; -- Read the required interval delivery lead relative to actual job/interval start. -- @param Value Ada-owned face-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Signed femtoseconds before job start and each successive interval start. function Tx_Rx_Switching_Time_FS (Value : Face_Info) return Interfaces.Integer_64;

name: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Tx_Switching_Time_FS
label: AMS.MEL.RF.Tx_Tx_Switching_Time_FS
text: function Tx_Tx_Switching_Time_FS (Value : Face_Info) return Interfaces.Integer_64; -- Read the minimum gap from a receive event to a subsequent transmit event. -- @param Value Ada-owned face-capability snapshot; no provider call is made. -- @return Provider-reported signed femtoseconds for RX then TX ordering. function Tx_Tx_Switching_Time_FS (Value : Face_Info) return Interfaces.Integer_64;

name: AMS.MEL.Session
label: AMS.MEL.Session
text: type Session is limited private; -- Copy the library description stored in a version snapshot. -- @param Value Ada-owned provider version snapshot. -- @return Independent Ada String of UTF-8 bytes, without transcoding. type Session is limited private;

name: AMS.MEL.Session_Options
label: AMS.MEL.Session_Options
text: type Session_Options is record Max_Async_Requests : Async_Request_Limit := 0; end record; -- Session-wide asynchronous admission bound; zero selects unlimited mode. type Session_Options is record Max_Async_Requests : Async_Request_Limit := 0; end record;

name: AMS.MEL.Vendor
label: AMS.MEL.Vendor
text: function Vendor (Value : Provider_Version) return String; -- Read the provider implementation-library number from a version snapshot. -- @param Value Ada-owned provider version snapshot. -- @return Unmodified provider library version number. function Vendor (Value : Provider_Version) return String;

name: AMS.MEL.Version
label: AMS.MEL.Version
text: type Version is record Major : Natural; Minor : Natural; end record; -- Consumer-side MEL bridge foundation and IR provider-session ownership. -- The native facade ABI version is independent of provider API and library -- versions. Child packages expose only the implemented MEL service slices. -- Serialize operations on an owner against its closure; this package does -- not provide a task-safe lifetime protocol for a shared Ada Session. type Version is record Major : Natural; Minor : Natural; end record;
